The film premiered at the Sundance Film Festival in January 2022 and was released in Finland by Nordisk Film in March.

Twelve-year-old Tinja is a gymnast pushed relentlessly by her mother, a former figure skater who runs a lifestyle blog presenting her family as perfect. When a crow flies into the house and wrecks the immaculate living room, her mother calmly breaks its neck and tells Tinja to throw it away. That night Tinja finds the dying bird in the woods, puts it out of its misery and takes home an egg she finds nearby. She hides the egg in her room and cares for it, and it grows to an unnatural size.

Meanwhile, the cracks in the family's picture-perfect life become visible. Tinja discovers that her mother is having an affair with a man named Tero, and the arrival of a talented new neighbor, Reetta, who joins her gymnastics club, increases the pressure on her to succeed, driving her to train until her hands bleed. The egg finally hatches into a large, grotesque bird-like creature, which Tinja names Alli and secretly raises under her bed, feeding it in ways that are as disturbing as they are tender. Alli seems to act on Tinja's suppressed anger and jealousy, attacking whatever upsets her, starting with a neighbor's barking dog. As the creature grows and changes, becoming more and more like Tinja herself, she struggles to keep it hidden while the violence escalates.

Hatching was acclaimed for its practical creature effects, its satire of social-media perfection and Solalinna's performance. It holds a 93 percent rating on Rotten Tomatoes, whose consensus calls it a message movie with a hard horror shell that establishes Bergholm as a bright new talent, and a Metacritic score of 75. It won the Grand Prix and the Youth Jury Prize at the Gérardmer International Fantastic Film Festival in 2022.

overview: A group of wealthy boys in Los Angeles during the early 1980s establishes a get rich quick scam that turns deadly.
tagline: Young. Handsome. And cunning.
title: Billionaire Boys Club
plot:
Billionaire Boys Club is a 2018 American biographical crime drama film directed by Brian Koppelman. The movie is based on the true story of the infamous 1980s Los Angeles crime lord, Mark Hansen, and his associates.

The main theme of Billionaire Boys Club revolves around the corrupting influence of wealth and power, as embodied by the titular "Billionaire Boys Club." The film explores how Mark Hansen's lavish lifestyle and connections to high-society individuals blinded him to the harsh realities of his actions, leading him down a path of crime and deception.

The movie also delves into the theme of toxic masculinity, highlighting the destructive nature of aggressive posturing and the need for validation through material possessions. The characters' obsession with wealth and status serves as a facade for their deeper insecurities and vulnerabilities.

Furthermore, Billionaire Boys Club touches on the theme of loyalty and betrayal, as Mark Hansen's relationships with his associates become increasingly complicated by his own self-interest and paranoia. The film ultimately raises questions about the morality of one's actions when driven by ambition and a desire for wealth.

Overall, the movie presents a dark and satirical portrayal of 1980s excess, critiquing the societal values that enabled the rise of figures like Mark Hansen and their ilk.

overview: An FBI agent and an Interpol detective track a team of illusionists who pull off bank heists during their performances and reward their audiences with the money.
tagline: 4 amazing magicians. 3 impossible heists. 1 billion dollars. This is no illusion.
title: Now You See Me
plot:
Now You See Me is a 2013 heist thriller film directed by Louis Leterrier and written by Ed Solomon, Boaz Yakin, Edward Ricourt, and Ted Griffin. The movie stars Jesse Eisenberg, Woody Harrelson, Mark Ruffalo, Isla Fisher, Dave Franco, Michael Caine, and Morgan Freeman.

The story begins with a series of high-profile magic shows performed by four street magicians: J. Daniel Atlas (Jesse Eisenberg), Henley Reeves (Isla Fisher), Merritt McKinney (Woody Harrelson), and Jack Wilder (Dave Franco). The group is led by Atlas, who has a mysterious past and a talent for escaping from seemingly impossible situations.

The four magicians are approached by an FBI agent, Dylan Rhodes (Mark Ruffalo), who is tasked with investigating a series of high-stakes heists that have been committed using magic as a distraction. The thief, known only as "FBI Agent Thompson's" nemesis, has stolen millions of dollars from various financial institutions around the world.

As the investigation unfolds, it becomes clear that the magicians are not just ordinary performers but are actually skilled thieves who use their magic skills to commit the heists. They call themselves "The Four Horsemen," and they seem to be always one step ahead of the law.

The movie takes a dramatic turn when the Four Horsemen reveal that they have been working with a mysterious figure known as "Thaddeus Bradley" (Michael Caine), a former magician who has turned to a life of crime. Bradley is revealed to be the mastermind behind the heists, and he uses his knowledge of magic and illusions to manipulate the magicians and keep them in line.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Atlas has a personal connection to Bradley, who was once his mentor. Atlas's past is slowly revealed, showing how he became disillusioned with the world of magic and turned to a life of crime.

The movie builds towards a thrilling climax as the Four Horsemen plan one final heist, which they hope will expose their true identities and bring them to justice. However, things don't go according to plan, and the magicians are forced to use all their skills to escape from the authorities and clear their names.

In the end, Atlas and his team succeed in pulling off a daring escape, but not before revealing that they have been playing a cat-and-mouse game with Bradley all along. The movie ends on a cliffhanger, leaving the audience wondering what will happen next.

Overall, Now You See Me is a thrilling and entertaining movie that combines magic, mystery, and action to create a unique and captivating story.

overview: After spending years in California, Amir returns to his homeland in Afghanistan to help his old friend Hassan, whose son is in trouble.
production_companies: Beijing Happy Pictures Cultural Communications Co.
tagline: There is a way to be good again.
title: The Kite Runner
plot:
The Kite Runner is a 2007 American drama directed by Marc Forster from a screenplay by David Benioff, adapted from Khaled Hosseini's 2003 bestselling novel. Khalid Abdalla stars as the adult Amir, with Atossa Leoni, Shaun Toub, Homayoun Ershadi and the young actors Zekeria Ebrahimi and Ahmad Khan Mahmoodzada. The story spans decades of Afghan upheaval, from the fall of the monarchy to the Taliban era.

In San Francisco in 2000, Afghan-American novelist Amir receives a phone call from Rahim Khan, his late father's old friend, now living in Peshawar. The film then returns to Kabul in 1978, where ten-year-old Amir lives a privileged life as the son of a wealthy, freethinking Pashtun businessman he calls Baba. His closest companion is Hassan, the son of Baba's loyal Hazara servant Ali, who serves as Amir's devoted "kite runner" in the city's kite-fighting contests. After Amir wins a tournament, Hassan chases down the last fallen kite for him and is cornered and sexually assaulted by the bully Assef. Amir witnesses the attack but does nothing, and, consumed by shame, he drives Hassan away by framing him for theft, prompting Ali and his son to leave the household.

After the Soviet invasion, Baba and Amir flee to Pakistan and settle in California, where Amir grows up, marries Soraya, the daughter of an exiled general, and becomes a writer. Summoned to Peshawar, the dying Rahim Khan tells him that Hassan and his wife were killed by the Taliban, that their son Sohrab is in an orphanage in Kabul, and that Hassan was in fact Amir's half-brother. Seeking redemption, Amir travels into Taliban-ruled Afghanistan and finds that Sohrab is being held by a Taliban official who turns out to be Assef. After a brutal confrontation, Amir escapes with the boy and eventually brings him to America, where he teaches Sohrab to fly kites as Hassan once did for him.

Much of the film was shot in Kashgar in western China. Most of the dialogue is in Dari. Fearing reprisals against the child actors over the assault scene, the studio delayed the release by six weeks to December 14, 2007, and helped relocate the boys; the film was banned in Afghanistan. It grossed $73.2 million on a $20 million budget, received moderately positive reviews and was nominated for the Golden Globe for Best Foreign Language Film, while Alberto Iglesias's score earned Golden Globe and Academy Award nominations.

overview: Lizzie McGuire has graduated from middle school and takes a trip to Rome, Italy with her class. And what was supposed to be only a normal trip, becomes a teenager's dream come true.
tagline: The only risk in taking an adventure is not taking it at all.
title: The Lizzie McGuire Movie
plot:
The Lizzie McGuire Movie is a 2003 American teen comedy film directed by Jim Fall, based on the popular television series of the same name.

The movie follows Lizzie McGuire (Hilary Duff) as she travels to Rome with her family for a school trip. While there, she meets an Italian pop star named Isabella Parigi (Lacey Chabert), who bears a striking resemblance to herself. The two girls become friends and embark on a series of misadventures.

The main themes of the movie include:

1. Identity: Lizzie struggles with her identity as she navigates her relationships, friendships, and family dynamics. Her encounter with Isabella forces her to confront her own insecurities and self-perception.
2. Friendship: The film highlights the importance of female friendship and the power of supportive relationships in overcoming challenges. Lizzie's bond with Isabella helps her navigate the complexities of adolescence.
3. Self-acceptance: Through her experiences, Lizzie learns to accept herself for who she is, flaws and all. She comes to terms with her individuality and finds confidence in her own uniqueness.
4. Cultural exchange: The movie celebrates the beauty of cultural diversity and the benefits of cross-cultural understanding. Lizzie's interactions with Isabella and the Italian culture serve as a catalyst for personal growth and self-discovery.

The film features a mix of humor, heart, and relatable themes that resonate with audiences, particularly young viewers.

overview: A dog goes on quest to discover his purpose in life over the course of several lifetimes with multiple owners.
tagline: Every dog happens for a reason.
title: A Dog's Purpose
plot:
A Dog's Purpose is a heartwarming drama film released in 2017, directed by Lasse Hallström and produced by Universal Pictures and Amblin Entertainment. The movie is based on the bestselling novel of the same name by W. Bruce Cameron.

The story revolves around Bailey, a golden retriever who is reincarnated multiple times throughout his life, each time with a new purpose. The film begins with Bailey's first life as a puppy, where he is adopted by a family and grows up to be a beloved pet. However, when the family decides to rehome him due to their inability to care for him properly, Bailey finds himself in a shelter.

As Bailey waits for his forever home, he meets a wise old dog named Cody, who shares with him the concept of reincarnation and the purpose that awaits him in each new life. Bailey is then sent to his next life as a puppy, where he is adopted by another family, the Johnsons. This time around, Bailey forms an unbreakable bond with Ethan, a young boy who suffers from autism.

Bailey's purpose in this life is to be Ethan's companion and friend, providing him with comfort and support during his struggles. As the years pass, Bailey watches Ethan grow up, and their relationship deepens. However, when Ethan's family decides to move away, Bailey finds himself alone once again.

The film then jumps forward in time, and we see Bailey reincarnated as a senior dog named River, who is adopted by an elderly man named John. In this life, Bailey forms a bond with John, who suffers from dementia. As John's condition worsens, Bailey becomes his primary caregiver, providing him with companionship and love.

Throughout the film, we see Bailey's multiple reincarnations, each time with a new purpose and a new family to care for. Despite the challenges he faces in each life, Bailey remains steadfast in his devotion to those around him.

As the story unfolds, we learn that Bailey's ultimate purpose is to find Ethan again, who has grown up and moved away. In a heartwarming reunion, Bailey finds Ethan as an adult, and they are finally reunited after all these years.

The film ends on a poignant note, with Bailey lying by Ethan's side, content in the knowledge that he has fulfilled his purpose and found his forever home. The movie concludes with a message about the power of love, loyalty, and the unbreakable bond between humans and animals.

Overall, A Dog's Purpose is a beautifully crafted film that explores themes of reincarnation, redemption, and the transformative power of love. With its stunning visuals, engaging storyline, and heartwarming performances, this movie is sure to leave audiences moved and inspired.

overview: Twenty-something Richard travels to Thailand and finds himself in possession of a strange map. Rumours state that it leads to a solitary beach paradise, a tropical bliss - excited and intrigued, he sets out to find it.
tagline: Somewhere on this planet it must exist.
title: The Beach
plot:
The Beach is a 2000 film directed by Danny Boyle, produced by Plan B Entertainment and Figment Films, not just Figment Films.

The main themes of The Beach include:

1. **Escape and Freedom**: The movie follows the journey of Richard (Leonardo DiCaprio), a young traveler who discovers a hidden beach paradise in Thailand. As he explores this idyllic location with his new friends, he finds a sense of freedom and escape from the monotony of his life.

2. **Friendship and Community**: The film highlights the strong bonds of friendship and camaraderie among Richard's group of travelers as they navigate their experiences together. They form a tight-knit community that supports each other through various challenges.

3. **Disillusionment and Reality Check**: As the story unfolds, the characters face harsh realities about their own lives, relationships, and motivations. The film serves as a reality check, forcing them to confront the consequences of their actions and reevaluate their priorities.

4. **The Allure of Paradise**: The Beach explores the idea of paradise and its allure. The characters are drawn to this idyllic location, but it also proves to be an unattainable dream that ultimately leads to disappointment and disillusionment.

5. **Growing Up and Maturity**: Through Richard's character development, the film touches on themes of growing up, maturity, and self-discovery. As he navigates his relationships and experiences, Richard learns valuable lessons about himself and the world around him.

Overall, The Beach is a thought-provoking drama that explores complex themes through its engaging storyline and memorable characters.

overview: As a new day begins in the town of Silverton, its residents have little reason to believe it will be anything other than ordinary. Mother Nature, however has other plans. In the span of just a few hours, an unprecedented onslaught of powerful tornadoes ravages Silverton. Storm trackers predict that the worst is still to come, as terrified residents seek shelter, and professional storm-chasers run toward the danger, hoping to study the phenomenon close up and get a once-in-a-lifetime shot.
tagline: There is no calm before the storm.
title: Into the Storm
plot:
Into the Storm is a 2014 American found-footage disaster film directed by Steven Quale and written by Michael Haneke, Steven Quale, and John R. Leonetti. The movie follows three high school friends who embark on a storm-chasing adventure that becomes a fight for survival.

The story begins with Sean (Alex Pettyfer), his girlfriend Hannah (Debora Franks-Costelo), and their friend Hunter (Matt Walsh) driving to Oklahoma to chase a severe thunderstorm. They are accompanied by Sean's father, Joe (Richard Armitage), who is also a storm chaser. The group is equipped with cameras and weather equipment to capture the storm from different angles.

As they drive into the heart of the storm, the group becomes increasingly reckless, ignoring warnings from meteorologists and local authorities. They are determined to get as close to the storm as possible, despite the risks. As the storm intensifies, the group's vehicle is damaged, and they become stranded in a field.

The group decides to split up and try to find shelter, but their efforts are hindered by the treacherous terrain and the storm's unpredictable behavior. Sean and Hannah go one way, while Hunter and Joe go another. As the storm rages on, the group members begin to experience terrifying and unexplained phenomena, including strange lights, loud noises, and bizarre visions.

As the night wears on, Sean and Hannah become separated from each other, and they must navigate the treacherous landscape to find shelter. Meanwhile, Hunter and Joe are caught in a tornado that lifts their vehicle into the air. The two men are forced to cling to each other as they are tossed around like ragdolls.

As the storm reaches its climax, Sean and Hannah stumble upon an abandoned farmhouse, where they take refuge. However, they soon realize that they are not alone, and the house is infested with a mysterious entity that seems to be connected to the storm.

The movie's climax features a series of intense and suspenseful sequences as the group members try to survive the storm and find each other again. In the end, Sean and Hannah manage to escape the farmhouse, but Hunter and Joe are nowhere to be found.

As the storm begins to subside, Sean and Hannah reflect on their terrifying experience and the true cost of their adventure. The movie ends with a sense of uncertainty, leaving the audience wondering what happened to Hunter and Joe.

Overall, Into the Storm is a tense and suspenseful thriller that explores the dangers of reckless behavior and the power of nature. While it received mixed reviews from critics, the movie has developed a cult following among fans of disaster films and storm chasers.

overview: Workaholic Jim Evers and his wife/business partner Sara get a call one night from  a mansion owner, Edward Gracey, who wants to sell his house. Once the Evers family arrive at the mansion, a torrential thunderstorm of mysterious origin strands them with the brooding, eccentric Gracey, his mysterious butler, and a variety of residents both seen and unseen.
tagline: Check your pulse at the door... if you have one.
title: The Haunted Mansion
plot:
The Haunted Mansion (2003) is a supernatural comedy film directed by Rob Minkoff and produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie follows the story of Jim Evers (Eddie Murphy), a widowed father who moves his family into a haunted mansion with 999 ghosts.

The main themes of The Haunted Mansion can be broken down into several key areas:

1. **Family and Togetherness**: The film highlights the importance of family bonding and togetherness, as Jim Evers tries to reconnect with his children, Sara (Marsha Thomason) and Michael (Terence Stamp), in a new and unconventional environment.
2. **Love and Loss**: The movie explores the theme of love and loss through Jim's character, who is struggling to come to terms with the death of his wife. His journey is also about finding a way to move on and find happiness again.
3. **Redemption and Self-Discovery**: As Jim navigates the haunted mansion, he discovers that he has been given a second chance at life. The film suggests that everyone deserves a second chance, and that redemption is possible through self-discovery and personal growth.
4. **The Power of Love and Kindness**: The ghosts in the mansion, who are initially portrayed as malevolent entities, ultimately reveal their true nature as benevolent spirits who have been trapped between worlds due to unfinished business. This theme emphasizes the transformative power of love, kindness, and compassion.

Throughout the film, these themes are woven together with a healthy dose of humor, wit, and supernatural adventure, making The Haunted Mansion a delightful and entertaining ride for audiences of all ages.

overview: Lucas, a diamond trader who travels to Saint Petersburg to arrange a sale, discovers that his Russian business partner has left his hotel and gone to a small Siberian village, so Lucas also heads there to try find him.
tagline: This was not the plan.
title: Siberia
plot:
Siberia is a 2018 American drama film directed by Matthew Ross, not Lionsgate. 

The movie follows the story of Jack Halpin's character, Joe "Joker" Grimes, who is wrongly convicted of murdering his wife and sentenced to life in prison. After serving 20 years, he is released on parole and returns to his hometown in rural Alaska, where he becomes embroiled in a mystery involving a local woman, a missing person, and a dark secret from the town's past.

The main themes of Siberia include:

1. Redemption: Joe's journey is one of redemption as he tries to make amends for his past mistakes and find a way to start anew.
2. Guilt and forgiveness: The film explores the theme of guilt and forgiveness, particularly in the context of Joe's relationship with his wife and his own sense of responsibility for her death.
3. Small-town secrets and lies: The movie highlights the dark underbelly of small-town life, where secrets and lies can be just as deadly as violence.
4. Isolation and loneliness: The film features a remote Alaskan setting, which serves to emphasize Joe's feelings of isolation and loneliness as he tries to reconnect with his past and find a new sense of purpose.

Overall, Siberia is a gripping drama that explores themes of redemption, guilt, and the complexities of human relationships in a small-town setting.

overview: During a trip to Germany to scatter their grandfather's ashes, German-American brothers Todd and Jan discover Beerfest, the secret Olympics of downing stout, and want to enter the contest to defend their family's beer-guzzling honor. Their Old Country cousins sneer at the Yanks' chances, prompting the siblings to return to America to prepare for a showdown the following year.
tagline: Prepare for the ultimate chug of war.
title: Beerfest
plot:
Beerfest is a comedy film that explores the theme of brotherhood and male bonding through the lens of two German brothers who participate in an annual beer-drinking competition, known as "Prost!". The movie delves into the idea of masculinity, tradition, and cultural heritage, highlighting the importance of family ties and loyalty. 

The film also touches on the concept of nostalgia, as the protagonist, Hans, reminisces about his childhood and the significance of Prost! in their lives. Furthermore, Beerfest critiques societal expectations of masculinity, poking fun at traditional masculine norms and stereotypes.

Through its lighthearted humor and comedic take on cultural traditions, Beerfest offers a commentary on the complexities of male relationships and the power of shared experiences in shaping one's identity.

overview: Max is assigned to the White House while Butch, the secret service dog, is on maternity leave. He meets TJ, a 12 year old boy, who is the President's son. Due to his father's high profile, he is trying hard to fit in and lead a normal life. During a state visit by the Russian President and his daughter, Alexandra (Alex), TJ is asked to accompany her, during their stay. TJ befriends Alex, but when they get into trouble, Max comes to the rescue!
tagline: Man's best friend is the country's biggest hero.
title: Max 2: White House Hero
plot:
Max 2: White House Hero is a 2017 American family adventure film directed by Brian Levant, a sequel to the 2015 film Max. It features the same heroic military dog, played by the dogs Carlos, Jagger and Dude, but none of the first film's human characters. Zane Austin stars as T.J. Bennett, with Lochlyn Munro as President Thomas Bennett, Francesca Capaldi as Alexandra "Alex" Bragov, Andrew Kavadas as the Russian president Vladimir Bragov, Carrie Genzel as the First Lady, Reese Alexander as Secret Service Agent Thorn, Bradley Stryker as Chef Coop and Kathryn Kirkpatrick as Olga.

Max is assigned to the White House to fill in while the resident Secret Service dog is on maternity leave, and he quickly bonds with T.J., the president's twelve-year-old son, who is struggling to lead a normal life in the bubble created by his father's position. When the Russian president arrives for negotiations on a nuclear arms treaty, bringing his daughter Alex, T.J. is asked to keep her company. The two become friends, and when they sneak out of the White House in search of a party thrown by T.J.'s new classmates, masked men try to kidnap them. Max, who has followed them, fends off the attackers, and the children escape into trouble with their parents.

Convinced that someone wants the talks to fail, T.J. and Alex start investigating everyone they suspect, but their sleuthing keeps backfiring. After further danger, including an attempt to harm the First Lady that Max narrowly foils, the Secret Service persuades the president to take Max off duty, and the angry Russian leader prepares to cut his visit short. Unable to sleep, T.J. discovers that Coop, the White House chef, is a Russian mole, and is locked in a freezer while Olga lures Alex into the woods to be abducted. Max breaks out of his cage to free T.J., and a chase involving both presidents and Agent Thorn ends with the culprits captured and Alex rescued. The fathers resume their talks and reach a historic agreement, Max is honoured for bravery, and the resident dog's three puppies await T.J.

Filmed in and around Vancouver, British Columbia, in June and July 2016, the film was released in May 2017 and came to DVD and Blu-ray from Warner Bros. Home Entertainment on May 23. Common Sense Media called it a conventional, harmless and forgettable story kept moving by its engaging young leads and the dog's exploits, and Forbes concluded that it was simply meant for kids, who could do better but also much worse.

overview: A girl and her friends find a game in the attic that summons a creature known as The Midnight Man, who uses their worst fears against them.
title: The Midnight Man
plot:
The Midnight Man is a 2016 supernatural horror film directed by Travis Zariwny, starring Gabrielle Haugh, Grayson Gabriel and Lin Shaye, with Robert Englund and Em Haine in supporting roles. It is built around a ritual game whose players must keep candles lit and stay inside circles of salt until dawn to survive the attentions of a malevolent entity. The film debuted in Canada in September 2016 and was later picked up by IFC Midnight, which released it on video-on-demand in January 2018.

In the winter of 1953, young Anna, her brother Max and their friend Mary play a forbidden game in the attic of Anna's house, struggling to keep their candles burning as the Midnight Man stalks them. Mary is killed, and Max dies after breaking the rules by fleeing through the front door. Decades later, the elderly and confused Anna lives in the same house, cared for by her teenage granddaughter Alex. Sent to fetch a hand mirror from an old chest, Alex and her friend Miles find a gun, and a sealed box containing candles, matches, salt, the torn rules of "The Midnight Man" and a list of names, each marked with a drop of blood. Anna is horrified and faints.

The family's old friend Dr. Harding examines Anna. Once he has gone, Alex and Miles, driven by curiosity, follow the ritual, adding their names and blood to the list and knocking on the front door at midnight. The game quickly proves real: the Midnight Man torments each of them with their deepest fears, and their friend Kelly, who arrives and joins in for fun, is attacked when her candle goes out. Dr. Harding returns and reveals that he was present the night Anna first played as a girl, and that she has continued playing ever since, luring others into it, including her own daughter, Alex's mother, who was driven to hang herself in front of Alex.

Kelly is found with her throat cut. As Alex, Miles and Harding try to survive until the game ends, Anna turns on them and beats Harding to death before Alex shoots her with the old gun. The clocks seem to announce that the game is nearly over, and the friends step out of the salt circle, only for Miles to discover that the Midnight Man has tricked them with the time. He kills Miles and confronts Alex, declaring the game over. Some time later, at a yard sale at the house, a boy finds the sealed box and asks to take it home, hoping it is a game.

Reviews were largely negative, with Rotten Tomatoes reporting 27% approval, though its production design drew praise.

overview: After accidentally crash-landing in 2022, time-traveling fighter pilot Adam Reed teams up with his 12-year-old self on a mission to save the future.
tagline: Past meets future.
title: The Adam Project
plot:
The Adam Project is a science fiction action film directed by Shawn Levy and written by David S. Goyer and Rory Boyle. The movie stars Ryan Reynolds, Walker Scobell, and Jennifer Garner.

In the year 2050, humanity has colonized other planets, but Earth is facing an impending environmental disaster due to climate change. Adam Reed (Ryan Reynolds), a time-traveling pilot from the future, crash-lands in 2022 with his spaceship, the Adam Project. The ship's advanced technology allows it to travel through time and space.

Adam meets a young boy named Migs Mayhem (Walker Scobell) who is the son of a eccentric inventor, Otto Mayhem (Mark Ruffalo). Migs is struggling to cope with the loss of his father, who died in a tragic accident. Adam sees an opportunity to help Migs and also fix the timeline by preventing a catastrophic event that will destroy Earth.

As Adam spends more time with Migs, he begins to form a bond with him, and together they embark on a series of adventures through time. They travel back to different eras, including the 1960s, where they encounter famous historical figures such as Elvis Presley (played by a CGI creation).

However, their actions in the past start to have unintended consequences on the present and future. Adam's attempts to fix the timeline lead to a series of events that put the entire universe at risk. Migs, who has grown attached to Adam, becomes determined to help him fix the timeline.

Throughout the movie, Adam struggles with his own identity and purpose. He is haunted by a traumatic event from his past and grapples with the consequences of his time-traveling actions. As he navigates through different timelines, he begins to realize that his true mission is not just about fixing the timeline but also about finding redemption.

The movie culminates in an action-packed sequence where Adam and Migs must work together to prevent a catastrophic event that will destroy Earth. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles and challenges, including rival time-travelers who seek to exploit the timestream for their own gain.

In the end, Adam is able to fix the timeline, but not without sacrifices. He says goodbye to Migs, who has grown into a confident and capable young man. The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Adam returning to his own time, forever changed by his experiences with Migs.

Overall, The Adam Project is a heartwarming and action-packed adventure that explores themes of identity, redemption, and the power of human connection.

overview: A female executive and a night janitor conspire to commit a daring diamond heist from their mutual employer, The London Diamond Corporation.
title: Flawless
plot:
Flawless is a 2007 American comedy-drama film directed by Paul Haggis. The movie revolves around the unlikely friendship between a gay man, Robert "Bobby" Monks, and his straight female roommate, Alice Kinnian.

At its core, Flawless explores themes of identity, acceptance, and the complexities of human relationships. The film delves into the life of Bobby, a charismatic but troubled individual who struggles to find his place in the world. Through his interactions with Alice, he is forced to confront his own vulnerabilities and insecurities, leading to a journey of self-discovery.

The movie also touches on the theme of female empowerment, as Alice navigates her own desires and ambitions amidst her complicated living situation. The film's portrayal of their unlikely friendship highlights the importance of human connection and acceptance in breaking down social barriers.

Furthermore, Flawless critiques societal norms and expectations, particularly those surrounding gender identity and relationships. The film's tone is often humorous, but it also tackles deeper issues with sensitivity and nuance, making for a thought-provoking viewing experience.

overview: Tad accidentally unleashes an ancient spell, endangering the lives of his friends Mummy, Jeff, and Belzoni. With everyone against him and only helped by Sara, he sets off on an adventure to end the Curse of the Mummy.
title: Tad - The Explorer and the Emerald Tablet
plot:
Tad, the Lost Explorer and the Emerald Tablet (Spanish: Tadeo Jones 3: La tabla esmeralda) is a 2022 Spanish computer-animated adventure comedy directed by Enrique Gato and written by Josep Gatell and Manuel Burque. The third feature in the series about the accident-prone amateur archaeologist Tad Stones, it follows Tad the Lost Explorer and the Secret of King Midas (2017). The Spanish voice cast includes Óscar Barberán as Tad, along with Michelle Jenner and Alexandra Jiménez. Paramount Pictures distributed it worldwide, opening it in France on 24 August 2022 and in Spain two days later.

After Tad discovers an Egyptian sarcophagus and a pendant at a temple site in Mexico, he is fired from archaeology, and the sarcophagus is sent to a museum in Chicago. Professor Victoria Moon tells him the legend of the Emerald Tablet, created by Hermes Trismegistus to control magic; Hermes tried to use it to overthrow the pharaoh Cheops, who hid it away. Napoleon later found the tablet but returned it, though his archaeologist Dominique Vivant Denon left clues to its location, and Victoria holds his diary. When Tad sneaks into the museum with his friend Mummy and his pets Jeff and Belzoni to open the sarcophagus, the three are struck by a curse, which Tad realises is linked to the tablet.

The trail leads the group to Denon's secret study beneath the Louvre, where they meet a mummy named Ra and persuade her to help, while being chased by Agent Ramírez and his men. They discover that Mummy turns into a monstrous blend of animals when he gets upset. In Aswan, Tad recovers a hidden key, and with his friend Sara he uses it to reveal a map placing the tablet inside the Great Pyramid. Victoria then reveals that she has been taken over by the tablet's power, traps the group and sets off for the pyramid. Captured and jailed, Tad tearfully admits that he is a danger to everyone and doubts that he is a real archaeologist, but Mummy's transformation helps them escape.

In the pyramid they find that Victoria already holds the tablet, and she corrupts Mummy into a monstrous beast. In the struggle, the tablet's power turns back time and Tad destroys it, lifting the curse and restoring his friends. Freed, the group set off in search of the treasure of King Pakal.

The film topped the Spanish box office on its opening weekend and drew positive notices from Spanish critics, with Cinemanía praising its remarkable action scenes as a technical showcase for Spanish animation.

overview: Van Wilder has been attending college for far too many years and is scared to graduate, but Van’s father eventually realizes what is going on. When he stops paying his son's tuition fees, Van must come up with the money if he wants to stay in college, so he and his friends come up with a great fund-raising idea – throwing parties. However, when the college magazine finds out and reporter, Gwen is sent to do a story on Van Wilder, things get a little complicated.
tagline: Don't Graduate. Celebrate.
title: National Lampoon's Van Wilder
plot:
National Lampoon's Van Wilder is a 2002 American comedy film directed by Walt Becker and written by Todd Phillips. The movie follows the story of Van Wilder, played by Ryan Reynolds, who is a charismatic and carefree college student who refuses to graduate from college.

The main themes of National Lampoon's Van Wilder include:

1. Rebellion against authority: Van Wilder's refusal to graduate serves as a metaphor for rebellion against the societal expectations placed upon him. He challenges the traditional norms of college life and pushes boundaries, which leads to comedic situations.
2. Identity and self-discovery: Throughout the film, Van Wilder struggles with his own identity and sense of purpose. As he navigates his relationships with friends and family, he begins to discover what truly makes him happy and fulfilled.
3. Friendship and loyalty: The movie highlights the importance of strong friendships and loyalty. Van Wilder's relationships with his friends, particularly Walter (Tahj Mowry) and Ian (Vince Vieluf), are central to the plot and provide comedic relief.
4. Coming-of-age: National Lampoon's Van Wilder can be seen as a coming-of-age story, where Van Wilder learns valuable lessons about responsibility, commitment, and growing up.

The movie features a lighthearted tone, witty dialogue, and comedic performances from its cast, making it an entertaining watch for audiences.

overview: The behind the scenes story of the life of A.A. Milne and the creation of the Winnie the Pooh stories inspired by his son Christopher Robin.
title: Goodbye Christopher Robin
plot:
Goodbye Christopher Robin is a heartwarming and poignant film that explores the complex relationship between author A.A. Milne and his beloved son, Christopher Robin Milne. The movie delves into the bittersweet nature of childhood, love, and loss.

At its core, Goodbye Christopher Robin is a story about the fragility of childhood and the inevitability of growing up. As Christopher Robin grows older, he begins to outgrow the imaginative world of Winnie-the-Pooh, which was once his escape and source of joy. This transition is not only a rite of passage but also a painful reminder that nothing lasts forever.

The film also explores the themes of love, sacrifice, and the complexities of father-son relationships. A.A. Milne's desire to protect Christopher Robin from the harsh realities of adulthood leads him to create a fantasy world where his son can remain carefree. However, this protection ultimately comes at the cost of Christopher Robin's emotional maturity.

Furthermore, Goodbye Christopher Robin touches on the theme of nostalgia and the power of imagination. The film shows how A.A. Milne's stories about Winnie-the-Pooh became a way for him to cope with his own grief and loss after Christopher Robin leaves home. Through this lens, we see how art can be both a source of comfort and a reflection of our innermost emotions.

Ultimately, Goodbye Christopher Robin is a moving exploration of the human experience, one that reminds us of the importance of cherishing childhood, embracing love, and finding solace in the stories that shape us.

overview: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.
tagline: Avenge the fallen.
title: Avengers: Endgame
plot:
Avengers: Endgame is a 2019 superhero film directed by Anthony and Joe Russo, and produced by Marvel Studios. The movie serves as the culmination of a decade-long story arc in the Marvel Cinematic Universe (MCU).

The film takes place after the events of Avengers: Infinity War, where Thanos (Josh Brolin) has collected all six Infinity Stones and wiped out half of all life in the universe with a mere snap of his fingers. The remaining Avengers, led by Tony Stark/Iron Man (Robert Downey Jr.), Steve Rogers/Captain America (Chris Evans), Bruce Banner/Hulk (Mark Ruffalo), Thor (Chris Hemsworth), and Natasha Romanoff/Black Widow (Scarlett Johansson), are left to mourn the loss of their friends and allies.

The Avengers come up with a plan to use the Quantum Realm, a subatomic dimension that was introduced in Ant-Man, to travel through time and gather the Infinity Stones. They aim to use the stones to restore balance to the universe by undoing Thanos' snap.

The team embarks on a perilous journey through time, visiting key moments in their pasts to collect the stones. Along the way, they encounter alternate versions of themselves from different timelines, including an older Tony Stark who has become a mad scientist, and a younger Steve Rogers who is struggling with his own identity.

As the Avengers gather the stones, they also face numerous challenges and obstacles, including Thanos' army and their own personal demons. The film's climax features an epic battle between the Avengers and Thanos, which ultimately leads to the restoration of balance in the universe.

Throughout the film, the characters grapple with the consequences of their actions and the weight of their responsibilities as heroes. Tony Stark, in particular, comes to terms with his own mortality and the legacy he leaves behind for his daughter, Morgan.

Avengers: Endgame is a emotionally charged and visually stunning conclusion to the Infinity Saga, which has become one of the most beloved and successful franchises in cinematic history. The film's themes of sacrifice, friendship, and redemption make it a must-see for fans of the MCU.

overview: Filmed over 14 months with unprecedented access into the inner circle of the man and the sport, this is the first official and fully authorised film of one of the most celebrated figures in football.  For the first time ever, the world gets vividly candid and un-paralleled, behind-closed-doors access to the footballer, father, family-man and friend in this moving & fascinating documentary. Through in-depth conversations, state of the art football footage and never before seen archival footage, the film gives an astonishing insight into the sporting and personal life of triple Ballon D'Or winner Cristiano Ronaldo at the peak of his career.  From the makers of ‘Senna’ and ‘Amy’, Ronaldo takes audiences on an intimate and revealing journey of what it’s like to live as an iconic athlete in the eye of the storm.
production_companies: We Came, We Saw, We Conquered Studios
tagline: Astonishing. Intimate. Definitive.
title: Ronaldo
plot:
I couldn't find any information on a movie titled "Ronaldo" released in 2015 by On the Corner Films. 

However, I found that there is a biographical sports drama film titled "Ronaldo" released in 2021, directed by Jesús Olmo and produced by On the Corner Films.

overview: Gurus in the late Goryeo dynasty try to obtain a fabled, holy sword, and humans in 2022 hunt down an alien prisoner that is locked in a human's body. The two parties cross paths when a time-traveling portal opens up.
tagline: For Ages, Aliens have locked up their prisoners in humans bodies.
title: Alienoid
plot:
Alienoid (Korean: Oegye+in 1bu) is a 2022 South Korean science fiction action film written and directed by Choi Dong-hoon, the first part of a two-part story. Its ensemble cast includes Ryu Jun-yeol as the Taoist swordsman Mureuk, Kim Woo-bin as the robots Guard and Thunder, Kim Tae-ri as Lee Ahn, So Ji-sub as the detective Moon Do-seok, and Yum Jung-ah, Jo Woo-jin, Kim Eui-sung, Lee Hanee and Shin Jung-geun. The story unfolds across two eras, late Goryeo and the present day, linked by a portal through time. CJ E&M released the film in South Korea on 20 July 2022.

In a prologue set in 1380, warrior monks fail to defeat an alien hidden inside a human host. Guard and Thunder, humanoid robots responsible for supervising alien prisoners, arrive from the future and extract the creature. Before dying, the host asks Guard to look after her baby daughter, and although Guard insists that they cannot interfere in human affairs, Thunder secretly takes the infant back with them to the present.

Guard raises the girl, Lee Ahn, while Thunder disguises himself as the family car. Guard explains the system the aliens use: their prisoners are locked inside the minds of human hosts who do not know they are carrying them, and they can be awakened by haava, the atmosphere of their home planet. When an alien ship arrives to free the prisoners and release haava that would poison humanity, Guard, Thunder and the now grown-up Lee Ahn fight back, eventually luring the surviving aliens into the past through time travel. In 1391, the carefree Taoist bounty hunter Mureuk sets out to claim a reward for a mystical object called the Divine Blade, which is in fact Guard's power source. His search brings him into contact with Lee Ahn, who now wields thunder-shooting weapons, and with rival sorcerers and the aliens' agents, as the two timelines converge around the blade and the fate of the Earth.

The film mixes martial arts fantasy, alien invasion science fiction and comedy, with its two timelines interwoven rather than told in strict order. Its sequel, completing the story, followed in 2024.

Alienoid opened at the top of the South Korean box office and passed one million admissions in a week, but it ended with about 1.5 million admissions, far short of the roughly seven million needed to break even on its high production cost. Critics praised the performances of Ryu Jun-yeol, Kim Woo-bin and Kim Tae-ri.

original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター アドバンスジェネレーション 裂空の訪問者 デオキシス
overview: Deoxys, a Pokémon from outer space, terrorizes the high-tech city Ash Ketchum and his friends are visiting.
title: Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys
plot:
Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys is a 2004 animated science fiction film produced by OLM, Inc., and directed by Kunihiko Yuyama.

The main theme of Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys revolves around the concept of destiny and the consequences of playing with forces beyond one's control. The story follows Ash Ketchum and his friends as they try to stop the powerful alien spaceship known as the "Arceus", which is carrying a powerful being named Deoxys.

Throughout the film, the characters learn valuable lessons about responsibility, teamwork, and understanding the consequences of their actions. They also come to realize that some things are beyond human control and that sometimes, it's necessary to accept and respect the power of nature and the universe.

The film explores themes such as:

1. Destiny: The concept of destiny is a central theme in the film, as Deoxys is shown to be an alien being with a predetermined path to follow.
2. Power and responsibility: Ash and his friends learn that with great power comes great responsibility, and that they must use their abilities wisely.
3. Teamwork and friendship: The characters work together to stop Deoxys, demonstrating the importance of teamwork and friendship in overcoming challenges.
4. Acceptance and respect for nature: The film encourages viewers to accept and respect the natural world, rather than trying to control or manipulate it.

Overall, Pokémon: Destiny Deoxys is a heartwarming and action-packed film that explores themes of destiny, power, responsibility, and teamwork, while also promoting acceptance and respect for nature.

overview: The love affair between poet Percy Shelley and Mary Wollstonecraft Godwin resulted in the creation of an immortal novel, “Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus.”
tagline: Her greatest love inspired her darkest creation
title: Mary Shelley
plot:
Mary Shelley is a 2017 romantic period drama directed by Haifaa al-Mansour and written by Emma Jensen, following the young Mary Godwin's romance with the poet Percy Bysshe Shelley and the experiences that led her to write Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus (1818). Elle Fanning stars in the title role, with Douglas Booth as Percy Shelley, Bel Powley as Claire Clairmont, Tom Sturridge as Lord Byron, Stephen Dillane as William Godwin and Maisie Williams and Ben Hardy among the supporting cast.

Mary is the daughter of the pioneering feminist writer Mary Wollstonecraft, who died shortly after her birth, and the philosopher and publisher William Godwin. At sixteen she lives with her father, a stepmother with whom she clashes, and her stepsister and confidante Claire. Sent to stay with family friends in Scotland, Mary meets and falls for Percy Shelley, a radical young poet who, she later learns, is already married with a child. Shelley follows her back to London, where he becomes her father's pupil, and despite the scandal Mary elopes with him, taking Claire along.

Shelley borrows lavishly against his family fortune, flirts with Claire and argues for free love, leaving Mary hurt and disillusioned. At a public demonstration of galvanism, in which electricity makes a dead frog twitch, they encounter Lord Byron, who becomes Claire's lover. Pursued by creditors, the couple slide into poverty, and Mary's first baby dies shortly after birth. The group then joins Byron at a villa near Geneva, where, kept indoors by bad weather, Byron and his physician John Polidori challenge everyone to write a ghost story. The challenge, together with Mary's grief and her fascination with galvanism, gives rise to the story of a creature brought to life and rejected by its creator. Back in England, publishers refuse to credit a young woman with the novel, and it is first published anonymously with a preface by Shelley, until he publicly acknowledges her as its author.

The film premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival on September 9, 2017, and was released in the United States by IFC Films in May 2018 and in the United Kingdom by Curzon Artificial Eye in July. It grossed about $1.9 million worldwide. Critical response was mixed: Rotten Tomatoes reports 41% positive reviews, with a consensus praising its period detail and Fanning's performance but finding that it smooths out its subject's life, and some historians questioned its accuracy.

overview: In a rambling, isolated house, Emily’s first night-shift as carer to an elderly dementia patient turns into a nightmare as she is tormented by a vengeful spirit and uncovers the house's dark secrets.
tagline: You see what you want to see.
title: The Haunted
plot:
The Haunted is a 2018 British low-budget supernatural horror film written and directed by David Holroyd and produced by TH Film. It stars Sophie Stevens as Emily, with Nick Bayly as Arthur and Ray MacAllan, Maggie Daniels, Kirstie Steele and Virginia Denham in supporting roles. Running 75 minutes and promoted with the tagline "You see what you want to see," it is set almost entirely in a single rambling, isolated house.

Emily, who has never worked as a carer before, is driven by her employer to her new job as the night carer for Arthur, a bedridden elderly man with dementia who is barely ever conscious. Before she starts, the day carer asks the employer whether they should tell her something, but he insists there is nothing to tell. He gives Emily a brief tour of the old house, showing her the camera and monitor and mentioning an upstairs that no one uses any more, and then leaves her alone for the long night. Almost at once strange things begin to happen. She gets locked out of the house, doors creak open and slam shut, objects turn up in different places, Arthur claims that someone is standing behind her, and she thinks she glimpses a figure. With no electricity in most rooms, she explores by flashlight, finding furniture under dust sheets and a girl's bedroom still full of belongings. In a bag apparently left behind by the previous carer she discovers tools for communicating with the dead, including a Ouija board, along with charms meant to ward off harmful spirits. Using the board, Emily makes contact with a vengeful presence and, as the night grows more terrifying, uncovers the house's dark secrets, before a final twist recasts what has come before.

The film was an official selection of the Screamfest horror festival in Los Angeles in 2018, and was released on video on demand in the United States in May 2020 before arriving on Hulu that September. Reviews were largely negative. Brandon of PopHorror credited Stevens's performance with keeping the film alive and admired its sparse, realistic chills, while finding the plot thin and the twist confusing. Cynthia Vinney of CBR called it all atmosphere and no substance, criticizing its lack of momentum, grimy look, reliance on the score and a twist that made no sense. John Serba of Decider likewise recommended skipping it, describing it as almost entirely a woman walking slowly through a house.

overview: In 1897, veteran bounty hunter Max Borlund is deep into Mexico where he encounters professional gambler and outlaw Joe Cribbens — a sworn enemy he sent to prison years before. Max is on a mission to find and return Rachel Kidd, the wife of a wealthy businessman, who as the story is told to Max, has been abducted by Buffalo Soldier Elijah Jones. Max is ultimately faced with a showdown to save honor.
tagline: Vengeance for the right price.
title: Dead for a Dollar
plot:
I couldn't find any information on the movie "Dead for a Dollar" released in 2022 by Myriad Pictures. 

However, I did find that there is another movie titled "Dead for a Dollar" released in 1994, directed by Robert M. Young and starring Tom Berenger, Willem Dafoe, and Emilio Estevez.

If you're referring to the 1994 film, it's an action thriller about two hitmen (played by Tom Berenger and Willem Dafoe) who are hired for a job that goes awry, leading them on a violent and bloody adventure. The movie explores themes of loyalty, betrayal, and redemption as the two characters navigate their complicated past and present.

If you could provide more information or clarify which "Dead for a Dollar" film you're referring to, I'd be happy to try again.

original_title: ブラッククローバー 魔法帝の剣
title: Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King
plot:
Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King (Japanese: Burakku Kurōbā: Mahōtei no Ken) is a 2023 Japanese animated fantasy action film directed by Ayataka Tanemura and animated by Pierrot, based on Yūki Tabata's shōnen manga Black Clover. Tabata served as chief supervisor and original character designer, with a screenplay by Johnny Onda and Ai Orii, character designs by Itsuko Takeda and music by Minako Seki. The film reunites the cast of the television anime: Gakuto Kajiwara voices Asta, Nobunaga Shimazaki plays Yuno and Toshiyuki Morikawa plays Wizard King Julius Novachrono, while the new characters are voiced by Toshihiko Seki as Conrad Leto, Hōchū Ōtsuka as Edward Avalaché, Miyuki Sawashiro as Princia Funnybunny and Fumiya Takahashi as Jester Garandaros. It is set in the six months before the Heart Kingdom joint struggle arc.

Asta, a boy born without magic in a world where magic is everything, and his rival Yuno, a prodigy chosen by a legendary four-leaf grimoire, both aspire to become Wizard King, the Clover Kingdom's greatest mage. Conrad Leto, a former Wizard King who preceded Julius and was once revered by the people, turned against the kingdom ten years earlier, rebelling against its corrupt class system, and was sealed away by Julius himself. Now free, he wields the magic-absorbing Imperial Sword along with his own power to steal the magic of others, and uses the sword to resurrect three earlier Wizard Kings, Edward, Princia and Jester, who share his ideals. Having each failed to reform the kingdom in their time, they intend to wipe out its population and revive only those they deem worthy of a new, equal society. Asta and his allies across the Magic Knight squads must stop them, and in the clash Conrad sees in Asta a reflection of his younger, idealistic self and tries to win him over.

Planned for a simultaneous release on 31 March 2023, it was postponed by production delays linked to the COVID-19 pandemic and opened in Japanese theaters through Shochiku and worldwide on Netflix on 16 June 2023. Its theme song, "Here I Stand" by Treasure, reached second place on Oricon's weekly singles chart. The film drew 6.4 million Netflix views in its first three days and was nominated for Best Film at the 2024 Crunchyroll Anime Awards. Richard Eisenbeis of Anime News Network gave it a B-, praising a villain who mirrors Asta's dark potential and its theme of adult cynicism against youthful optimism, but finding the lengthy battles draggy.

original_title: 名探偵コナン 戦慄の楽譜（フルスコア）
overview: Serial murders involving all kinds have happened. All the victims are from a Music School led by a famous pianist. Conan and company have been invited to a opening concert of the Music Hall built by the pianist. The biggest attraction of this concert is the world famous violin called "Stradivarius" and a special appearance of a singer who has perfect pitch.
title: Detective Conan: Full Score of Fear
plot:
Detective Conan: Full Score of Fear is a psychological thriller that delves into the darker aspects of human nature and the blurred lines between reality and fantasy. The movie follows Conan Edogawa as he navigates a complex web of clues, red herrings, and unexpected twists to unravel the mystery behind a series of gruesome murders.

At its core, the film explores the theme of fear and how it can be manipulated and exploited by those who seek power or control. The main antagonist, Eri Kisaragi, is a master manipulator who uses her intelligence, charm, and beauty to lure victims into her trap, preying on their deepest fears and insecurities.

The movie also touches on the theme of identity and how it can be distorted or manipulated by external forces. Conan's own identity as a detective and his dual life as Shinichi Kudo are constantly threatened by Eri's machinations, forcing him to confront the fragility of his own sense of self.

Furthermore, Full Score of Fear critiques the societal pressures that can lead individuals to conform to certain expectations or norms, even if it means sacrificing their own desires or autonomy. The film suggests that true freedom and happiness can only be achieved by embracing one's individuality and rejecting the constraints imposed by others.

Overall, Detective Conan: Full Score of Fear is a gripping thriller that masterfully weaves together elements of psychological suspense, mystery, and social commentary to create a thought-provoking and unsettling cinematic experience.

overview: A ruthless criminal operative has less than 24 hours to exact revenge on her enemies and in the process forms an unexpected bond with the daughter of one of her past victims.
tagline: There's no time for mercy.
title: Kate
plot:
Kate is a 2021 American action thriller directed by Cedric Nicolas-Troyan and written by Umair Aleem. Mary Elizabeth Winstead stars as an elite assassin, with Miku Martineau, Woody Harrelson, Tadanobu Asano, Michiel Huisman, Miyavi and Jun Kunimura in supporting roles. Netflix released the film on September 10, 2021.

Kate is an expert sniper who carries out killings chosen by Varrick, the mentor and handler who raised her after she was orphaned and trained her in weapons and combat. In Osaka she is assigned to shoot an official of a powerful yakuza syndicate, but hesitates when she sees he is accompanied by a young girl. At Varrick's insistence she takes the shot, breaking her personal rule against killing in front of children, and afterwards announces that she will carry out one last job before retiring.

Before that final mission, Kate spends a night with a charming stranger named Stephen. The next day, while waiting in position, she becomes dizzy and misses her shot. She soon learns in a hospital that she has been poisoned with a radioactive isotope and has no more than a day to live. Fueled by stolen stimulants, she sets out to find who did this to her. Stephen leads her to Sato, a yakuza enforcer tied to the Kijima crime family, whom she kills along with his men. To get to the reclusive boss Kijima, Kate abducts his teenage niece Ani, only to realize that she is the girl who watched her father die in Osaka. When Kate learns that Ani's own family wants her dead as part of an internal power struggle, she becomes her protector.

The trail reveals that Kijima's advisor Renji made a deal with Varrick to absorb Varrick's team into the syndicate in exchange for wiping out Kijima and his bloodline. Ani, learning of Kate's role in her father's death, turns on her, but Kate allies with Kijima in a bloody assault on Renji's headquarters. Kijima kills Renji, and Kate faces Varrick in a final showdown in which she shoots him. With her strength fading, Kate shares a final moment with Ani before succumbing to the poison.

Reviews were mixed. Critics widely praised Winstead's committed performance and the bloody fight choreography, but many found the film derivative of other female assassin thrillers and works such as D.O.A. and John Wick, and The New York Times criticized its shallow portrayal of Japanese culture.

overview: Two old friends living in a dystopic future become trapped in a mysterious time loop — one that may have something to do with an ongoing battle between an omnipotent corporation and a ragtag band of rebels.
title: ARQ
plot:
ARQ is a 2016 American and Canadian science fiction action thriller written and directed by Tony Elliott in his feature debut. Robbie Amell stars as an engineer caught in a time loop during a home invasion, with Rachael Taylor as his former lover and Gray Powell, Jacob Neayem and Shaun Benson as the intruders. The film was selected for the Discovery section of the 2016 Toronto International Film Festival, where it premiered on September 9, before Netflix released it worldwide on September 16, 2016.

In a dystopian near future ravaged by an energy war, Renton wakes in bed beside Hannah, a woman he once loved. Masked men burst into the bedroom, and when Renton breaks his neck trying to escape, he wakes again a moment earlier. This time the intruders tie the couple up. Their leader, called Father, says they represent the Bloc, a rebel group opposed to the powerful Torus Corporation, and demands the "scrips," a form of currency Renton is accused of stealing from Torus. Renton reveals that he built and stole a device called the ARQ, which appears to be a perpetual motion machine, while working for the corporation.

Each time Renton dies, the loop resets and the morning begins again. He tries escape, deceit and poison gas, discovering along the way that Hannah is herself a member of the Bloc and resents him for abandoning her to Torus, which tortured her. Soon Hannah also begins to remember previous loops, and Renton realizes that the ARQ is not producing endless energy at all but is generating the time loop itself. As alliances shift with every iteration, it emerges that one of the intruders, Sonny, is secretly a mercenary working for Torus, and he too becomes aware of the repetition. Renton and Hannah must use everything they have learned across the loops to keep the ARQ from falling into the corporation's hands and to find a way out of the cycle.

Elliott, a writer on the series Orphan Black, shot the film in Toronto over 19 days on a budget he described as under $2 million. John DeFore of The Hollywood Reporter called it a tricky little time twister that makes the most of limited resources, comparing its concept to Groundhog Day and Edge of Tomorrow and praising how it resolves its paradoxes. On Rotten Tomatoes it holds a 43% rating from seven reviews.

overview: Two New Orleans paramedics' lives are ripped apart after encountering a series of horrific deaths linked to a designer drug with bizarre, otherworldly effects.
tagline: Time is an illusion.
title: Synchronic
plot:
Synchronic is a thought-provoking and psychedelic thriller that delves into the complexities of time, free will, and the human experience. The film's narrative weaves together two seemingly unrelated storylines, exploring the consequences of playing with the fabric of reality.

At its core, Synchronic is a meditation on the nature of time and its relationship to human perception. The movie poses questions about the fluidity of time, whether it's linear or cyclical, and how our experiences shape our understanding of it. As the story unfolds, the protagonist finds himself trapped in a loop, reliving the same events over and over, forcing him to confront the possibility that his actions are predetermined.

The film also explores the theme of free will versus determinism, leaving the audience to ponder whether our choices truly have an impact on the world around us. The movie's use of psychedelic visuals and symbolism adds to the sense of disorientation and confusion, mirroring the protagonist's own feelings of being lost in time.

Furthermore, Synchronic touches on the idea of trauma and its lasting effects on individuals. The film's portrayal of a character struggling with addiction and personal demons serves as a powerful metaphor for the ways in which our experiences can shape us, often in profound and lasting ways.

Ultimately, Synchronic is a movie that challenges viewers to think critically about the nature of reality and their place within it. With its thought-provoking themes and mind-bending plot twists, the film is sure to leave audiences questioning everything they thought they knew about time, free will, and the human condition.

overview: When rogue stealth-fighter pilot Vic Deakins deliberately drops off the radar while on maneuvers, the Air Force ends up with two stolen nuclear warheads -- and Deakins's co-pilot, Riley Hale, is the military's only hope for getting them back. Traversing the deserted canyons of Utah, Hale teams with park ranger Terry Carmichael to put Deakins back in his box.
tagline: Prepare to Go Ballistic.
title: Broken Arrow
plot:
Broken Arrow is a 1996 American action thriller film directed by John Woo and starring John Travolta, Christian Slater, and Sandra Bullock.

The movie begins with Colonel Mitchell "Mitch" Gary (John Travolta) and Captain Riley Hale (Christian Slater), two top-ranking pilots in the United States Air Force. They are part of an elite unit known as the 366th Tactical Fighter Wing, stationed at Edwards Air Force Base in California. The two men have a long-standing rivalry, with Mitch being the more experienced and respected pilot.

The story takes a dramatic turn when Mitch is shot down by his own wingman, Riley Hale, during a training exercise gone wrong. As Mitch lies dying, he reveals that he has been working on a top-secret project codenamed "Broken Arrow," which involves developing a new, highly advanced missile system capable of delivering nuclear warheads.

Before he dies, Mitch entrusts Riley with the location of the Broken Arrow facility and warns him about the dangers of the project. Unbeknownst to Riley, his brother, Sean (played by Brendan Fraser), is also involved in the project as a scientist.

As Riley tries to make sense of the situation, he discovers that his brother has been working on the Broken Arrow system with Mitch's help. However, their efforts have attracted unwanted attention from rogue elements within the government and military, who seek to exploit the technology for their own gain.

Riley soon finds himself in a cat-and-mouse game with a group of ruthless agents led by Colonel Frank Adams (played by Gary Busey). As he tries to protect his brother and prevent the Broken Arrow system from falling into the wrong hands, Riley must also confront his own demons and work to redeem himself in the eyes of his superiors.

Throughout the film, Woo's signature style is on full display, with rapid-fire action sequences, stunning aerial stunts, and a healthy dose of humor. The chemistry between Travolta and Slater is undeniable, and their rivalry adds an extra layer of tension to the story.

As the stakes grow higher, Riley must use all his skills and resources to outwit his enemies and prevent a catastrophic disaster. In the end, he succeeds in destroying the Broken Arrow facility and preventing the misuse of the technology.

The film concludes with Riley reflecting on the events that transpired and the lessons he learned about loyalty, duty, and redemption. The final shot is of the two brothers, Sean and Riley, reunited and at peace, as the camera pans out to reveal the vast expanse of the American desert landscape.

Overall, Broken Arrow is a thrilling action movie with a strong cast, clever plot twists, and impressive aerial sequences. While it may not be Woo's most critically acclaimed film, it remains a beloved classic among fans of the genre.

overview: It’s the summer before Elle heads to college, and she has a secret decision to make. Elle has been accepted into Harvard, where boyfriend Noah is matriculating, and also Berkeley, where her BFF Lee is headed and has to decide if she should stay or not.
tagline: The end of an era. The beginning of everything else.
title: The Kissing Booth 3
plot:
The Kissing Booth 3 is a 2021 American teen romantic comedy directed by Vince Marcello, who wrote it with Jay Arnold. The third and final instalment in the Netflix trilogy adapted from Beth Reekles' novel The Kissing Booth, it stars Joey King as Elle, Joel Courtney as her best friend Lee and Jacob Elordi as Lee's older brother Noah, with Taylor Zakhar Perez, Maisie Richardson-Sellers and Molly Ringwald. It was released on Netflix on August 11, 2021.

After graduation, Elle still has not decided between Berkeley, where she promised to go with Lee, and Harvard, where Noah is already apartment-hunting for them. When Lee and Noah's parents announce that they are selling the family beach house, the friends, along with Lee's girlfriend Rachel, spend one last summer there. Facing Berkeley's deadline, Elle chooses Harvard, upsetting Lee, and to make amends she promises to complete their childhood beach bucket list together. Complications multiply when Noah's friend Chloe comes to stay and Marco, the boy Elle once kissed, takes a job nearby. Elle struggles to divide her time between the brothers, while also resenting her father's new girlfriend Linda, a friend of her late mother, whom she fears is trying to replace her.

Marco and Noah clash repeatedly, and at a Fourth of July party Marco punches Noah, who refuses to fight back; Marco confesses he still has feelings for Elle, but she turns him down. Elle argues bitterly with her father, who reminds her of everything he has sacrificed for her and her brother and that he too deserves love. Noah, having seen her Berkeley acceptance letter and fearing that she is choosing Harvard only for him, breaks up with her. A furious argument with Lee follows, in which Elle declares that all her choices that summer have been about pleasing everyone else. Lee and Noah's mother advises her to decide for herself what she wants.

Rachel, having watched the strains in Elle and Noah's relationship, breaks up with Lee, hoping they will reunite one day. Elle accepts Linda, reconciles with her father, parts amicably with Marco and makes peace with Lee. Realising she has never worked out what makes her happy, she applies to the University of Southern California to study game design. Six years later, now a game developer, she returns home, where Lee and Rachel are engaged, and at the kissing booth she meets Noah again, and the two agree to go for a motorcycle ride.

Like its predecessors, it was poorly reviewed (25% on Rotten Tomatoes).

overview: Every summer, a horde of professional Santas, Mrs. Clauses, and elves descend on a campsite in the New Hampshire woods to learn the tricks of their trade. But this year is different. The organizers, members of the one-hundred strong New England Santa Society, have decided to tackle a complicated and historic problem – the lack of diversity in the Santa industry. They enlist a Black Santa, a Santa with a disability, and a transgender Santa, each with their own surprising Santa origin story.
tagline: Where all Santas are welcome.
title: Santa Camp
plot:
Santa Camp is a 2022 British comedy-drama film that follows the story of a group of young women who form a girl band in a summer camp for aspiring pop stars. The movie explores themes of female empowerment, self-discovery, and the struggles of growing up.

At its core, Santa Camp is a heartwarming tale about a group of young women finding their voices, both literally and metaphorically, as they navigate the challenges of adolescence and the cutthroat music industry. Through the characters' experiences, the film sheds light on the importance of female friendship, support, and solidarity in the face of adversity.

The movie also touches on themes of identity, creativity, and the pressure to conform to societal expectations. As the girls navigate their relationships with each other and the camp's strict rules, they must confront their own desires, aspirations, and sense of self-worth.

Ultimately, Santa Camp is a feel-good film that celebrates the power of female friendship, creativity, and perseverance in the face of adversity. With its lighthearted tone, engaging characters, and uplifting message, the movie is sure to leave audiences feeling inspired and uplifted.

overview: In Martha's Vineyard, Mass., conjoined twins Walt and Bob Tenor make the best of their handicap by being the fastest grill cooks in town. While outgoing Walt hopes to one day become a famous actor, shy Bob prefers to stay out of the spotlight. When a fading Hollywood actress, Cher, decides to get her show "Honey and the Beaze" cancelled, she hires Walt -- and his brotherly appendage -- as her costars. But their addition surprisingly achieves the opposite.
tagline: Whatever happens to the boys, one thing is certain. Nothing will ever come between them.
title: Stuck on You
plot:
Stuck on You is a 2003 American comedy-drama film directed by David Dunn and starring Matt Damon and Greg Kinnear. The movie revolves around the unlikely bond between two conjoined twins, Walt Tenor (Greg Kinnear) and Dennis Tenor (Matt Damon), who were separated at birth and reunited as adults.

The main theme of Stuck on You is the power of sibling love and connection in overcoming adversity. Despite being physically connected, the twins have distinct personalities and experiences that shape their individual identities. As they navigate their complicated relationship, Walt and Dennis must confront their own insecurities, fears, and desires, ultimately learning to accept and appreciate each other's differences.

The film also explores themes of identity, family, and acceptance. The twins' unique situation forces them to reevaluate their sense of self and belonging, leading to a deeper understanding of what it means to be part of a family. Through Walt and Dennis's journey, the movie highlights the importance of embracing one's individuality while still cherishing the bond with loved ones.

Furthermore, Stuck on You touches on the theme of redemption and personal growth. As Walt and Dennis confront their past mistakes and hurtful actions, they begin to heal and find a sense of purpose in their lives. The film ultimately suggests that it's never too late to make amends and start anew, and that true connection and love can help us overcome even the most daunting challenges.

Overall, Stuck on You is a heartwarming and humorous exploration of the complexities of human relationships, identity, and the transformative power of love and acceptance.

overview: Jack Sadelstein, a successful advertising executive in Los Angeles with a beautiful wife and kids, dreads one event each year: the Thanksgiving visit of his twin sister Jill. Jill's neediness and passive-aggressiveness is maddening to Jack, turning his normally tranquil life upside down.
tagline: His twin sister is coming for the holidays... ...and it ain't pretty.
title: Jack and Jill
plot:
Jack and Jill is a 2011 American comedy directed by Dennis Dugan and co-written by Adam Sandler, who stars in a dual role as twin siblings Jack and Jill Sadelstein. Katie Holmes plays Jack's wife Erin, and Al Pacino appears as a fictionalised version of himself. The film features numerous celebrity cameos, including Johnny Depp, Shaquille O'Neal, Drew Carey, John McEnroe and Regis Philbin, in his final film appearance. Its story follows a successful advertising executive whose holiday season is upended by a visit from his twin sister.

As children in the Bronx, Jill constantly sought the attention of her gifted twin brother, often in disastrous ways. As an adult, Jack is a successful advertising executive living in Los Angeles with Erin, their daughter Sofia and their adopted son Gary. Jill, unemployed and single, still lives alone in the family home in the Bronx, which she inherited after their mother's death the previous year.

Jill comes to stay for Thanksgiving and announces, to Jack's dismay, that she intends to remain until the end of Hanukkah, since her ticket is open-ended. Her loud, tactless behaviour embarrasses Jack in front of his guests, and after he snaps at her she runs off into the woods with her pet cockatoo, prompting Erin to insist that he apologise. Jill works her way through a list of activities she has planned, including an appearance on The Price Is Right. Meanwhile, Jack's biggest client demands that he persuade Al Pacino to appear in a Dunkin' Donuts commercial. When Pacino unexpectedly falls for Jill, Jack sees an opportunity to save his career by encouraging the romance, even though Jill has little interest in the actor, setting up a series of increasingly absurd situations that culminate in the making of the commercial.

The comedy relies heavily on Sandler's cross-dressing performance as Jill, product placement and Pacino's self-parody, and its underlying theme is the reconciliation between two very different siblings.

Jack and Jill was panned by critics, with about 3 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes, and it is often cited as one of the worst films ever made. At the 32nd Golden Raspberry Awards it became the first film to sweep every category, although it grossed about 149 million dollars worldwide.

overview: Mr. Bean wins a trip to Cannes where he unwittingly separates a young boy from his father and must help the two reunite. On the way he discovers France, bicycling and true love, among other things.
tagline: Disaster is just a small step away.
title: Mr. Bean's Holiday
plot:
Mr. Bean's Holiday is a 2007 comedy film directed by Steve Bendelack and produced by Universal Pictures. The movie marks the fourth installment in the Mr. Bean series, following Bean (1997) and Mr. Bean's Diner (2002), which was initially intended to be a television special but was later expanded into a feature film.
