6. **Societal Commentary**: The film offers a commentary on contemporary society's relationship with technology, exploring themes such as surveillance, control, and the impact of technological advancements on individual freedom and autonomy.

These themes are woven throughout the narrative, adding depth and complexity to the story.

overview: In a dystopian near future, single people, according to the laws of The City, are taken to The Hotel, where they are obliged to find a romantic partner in forty-five days or are transformed into animals and sent off into The Woods.
tagline: An unconventional love story...
title: The Lobster
plot:
The Lobster is a 2015 black comedy film written and directed by Yorgos Lanthimos, produced by Haut et Court, and released by A24. The movie stars Colin Farrell, Rachel Weisz, John C. Reilly, and Olivia Colman.

In the not-too-distant future, single people are forced to find a mate within 45 days, or else they will be transformed into an animal of their choice. David (Colin Farrell), a recently divorced man, is taken to a hotel where he must find a partner within the given time frame. If he fails, he will be turned into an orangutan.

David checks into the hotel and meets his fellow guests, including a woman named Short Sighted Woman (Rachel Weisz) who has a condition that makes her unable to see colors. He also meets Long Sighted Man (John C. Reilly), who is obsessed with his girlfriend's eyes. The guests are given various tasks to complete in order to find their perfect match.

David tries to win the heart of Short Sighted Woman, but she rejects him after a few days. He then sets out on a journey to find her again, accompanied by a hotel employee named Short Sighted Woman (Olivia Colman), who is also his love interest. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles and challenges.

As David navigates through the hotel's rules and regulations, he begins to question the purpose of the institution and the true nature of relationships. He also starts to develop feelings for a woman named Short Sighted Woman (Léa Seydoux), who is not like the other guests.

The movie takes a dark and surreal turn as David and his companions are forced to undergo various forms of torture and humiliation in order to find their perfect match. The film's climax features a violent and disturbing confrontation between David and Long Sighted Man, which ultimately leads to a shocking twist.

Throughout the movie, Lanthimos explores themes of loneliness, relationships, and the societal pressures that come with modern dating. The Lobster is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that challenges its viewers to think critically about the nature of love and human connection.

The film's unique blend of humor, drama, and absurdity has made it a cult classic among film enthusiasts. Its success can be attributed to Lanthimos' bold direction and the talented cast, who deliver memorable performances that add depth and complexity to the story.

Overall, The Lobster is a thought-provoking and unsettling film that challenges its viewers to think critically about the nature of love and human connection. With its unique blend of humor, drama, and absurdity, it has become a cult classic among film enthusiasts.

overview: As Abraham Lincoln labors over the Gettysburg address, the importance of which he is fully aware, he learns that a menace from his past has returned, threatening to tear the already fractured nation to pieces. He must journey behind enemy lines to face an foe far more fearsome than the Confederate army: the walking dead.
tagline: He emancipated the slaves... he saved the union... and slaughtered the undead!
title: Abraham Lincoln vs. Zombies
plot:
Abraham Lincoln vs. Zombies is a 2012 comedy horror film that satirizes the zombie genre while also paying homage to classic Westerns and historical dramas. At its core, the movie explores the idea of a man out of time, Abraham Lincoln, finding himself in a world overrun by zombies.

The main theme of the film revolves around the concept of leadership and how it can be both inspiring and terrifying. The character of Abraham Lincoln, played as a zombie-hunting frontiersman, embodies the qualities of a strong leader who must make difficult decisions to protect his community. His leadership is tested when he must confront the undead hordes and navigate the complexities of human relationships in a post-apocalyptic world.

The movie also delves into the idea of identity and how it can be shaped by circumstances. Abraham Lincoln, as a zombie, must reconcile his past life with his new existence, all while trying to maintain some semblance of humanity in a world that has lost its way. This internal conflict serves as a metaphor for the human condition, where individuals must adapt to changing circumstances and find ways to hold on to their sense of self.

Furthermore, the film touches on the theme of community and how it can be both a source of strength and weakness. The group of survivors that Abraham Lincoln leads is comprised of misfits and outcasts, each with their own unique skills and personalities. As they navigate the zombie-infested landscape together, they must learn to trust and rely on one another in order to survive.

Ultimately, Abraham Lincoln vs. Zombies is a film about resilience and the human spirit's ability to persevere in the face of overwhelming adversity. Despite being set in a world gone mad, the movie retains a sense of humor and wit, making it an entertaining and thought-provoking watch.

overview: Follow the rise, fall, and reinvention of controversial and revered '90s television psychic Miss Cleo. Featuring interviews with celebrities and those closest to the self-proclaimed voodoo priestess, this documentary explores the many layers behind a complicated and charismatic figure.
tagline: The psychic scandal no one could have predicted.
title: Call Me Miss Cleo
plot:
Call Me Miss Cleo is a 2022 American documentary film directed by Celia Aniskovich and Jennifer Brea about Youree Dell Harris, the television psychic known as Miss Cleo, whose late-night infomercials for the Psychic Readers Network were ubiquitous between 1997 and 2003. Produced by Gunpowder & Sky and Dial Tone Films for HBO Max, it began streaming on the service on 15 December 2022 and runs 90 minutes. Its interviewees include Raven-Symoné and Debra Wilson, who parodied Miss Cleo on That's So Raven and MADtv respectively.

The film traces the rise and fall of Harris, who died of colon cancer in 2016 and whose voice guides the documentary through a 2012 interview recorded for the 2014 documentary Hotline. Born in Los Angeles, Harris adopted a Jamaican accent and presented herself as a voodoo priestess. Former colleagues at the Langston Hughes theatre in Seattle recall her as a playwright and performer who went by Ree Perris and say the Miss Cleo character grew out of a play she was developing there, before she disappeared without paying collaborators. After her tarot reading in a commercial reportedly brought the network its biggest surge of calls, she became the face of the psychic hotline craze, with talk show appearances, merchandise and parodies. Former phone psychics admit they were not psychic, followed scripts and were told to keep callers on the line, as the first three minutes were free and every minute afterwards cost $4.99. The film covers the thousands of complaints and the 2002 Federal Trade Commission fraud charges against the companies behind the network, and the Florida investigation that named Miss Cleo, with Harris insisting that she was a poorly paid contractor and that a collection letter bearing her signature was forged. Friends, former clients, journalists, scholars and former partners consider her aliases, her possible mental illness, the appeal of her appropriated accent and whether she was a gifted psychic or a master of deceit.

Critics were divided. Nick Schager of The Daily Beast argued that the film went far too easy on the scamming psychic despite its amusing archival material. Tony Sokol of Den of Geek felt the directors' great empathy for Harris undercut the case against her, producing a Behind the Music-style tale of a fallen celebrity rather than an in-depth study of a con.

overview: A recent widow is glad when her son finds a new friend. But it soon becomes clear that he's after a different type of companionship. Will their attraction be her undoing? And what secrets is hiding?
tagline: Revenge is only the beginning.
title: Cruel Fixation
plot:
Cruel Fixation is a 2019 American psychological thriller television film directed by Damián Romay for Sunshine Films and distributed by MarVista Entertainment. It premiered on the Lifetime network in October 2019 under the title Sinister Seduction. The film stars Kristina Klebe as a widowed mother, Tanner Buchanan as the teenager who insinuates himself into her family, and Sebastian Cabanas as her son, with Carson Rowland, Megan Ashley Brown, Susan Gallagher, Tommi Rose, Keith Hudson and Michael Houston King in supporting roles. It runs about 90 minutes.

Sharon Elliott (Klebe) runs her own real estate business and is raising her teenage son Anthony (Cabanas) alone after the mysterious murder of her husband Mark (King). Since his father's death Anthony has withdrawn from her and become socially isolated, struggling to fit in at school. Sharon is relieved and grateful when Dylan Warren (Buchanan), one of the most popular boys at the school, befriends Anthony and becomes a steadying presence for him. Dylan also becomes a sympathetic listener for Sharon herself, who confides in him about her conflicting feelings toward her late husband: Anthony grieves an idealised version of his father, while Sharon remembers Mark as a self-centred man who was hard to be married to. As Dylan spends more and more time at the house, Sharon begins to suspect that his interest lies with her rather than with her son. She does not realise that she and Dylan are bound by a dark connection from her past, or that his friendship with Anthony is part of a scheme of revenge against her, and she must uncover the truth before it destroys the family she has left.

Writing for Vocal, one Lifetime reviewer saw the film as a variation on one of the channel's most familiar premises, a vulnerable woman letting a secretly dangerous man into her life, but rated it highly for its well-developed characters, the emotionally charged scenes between mother and son, and an ending that avoids the usual Lifetime conventions in favour of a more realistic note. The review singled out Klebe's performance as well as the subtle menace and believable charm Buchanan brings to Dylan. Viewer reactions on IMDb were more divided, with several criticising the script and the supporting performances.

overview: With college decisions looming, Elle juggles her long-distance romance with Noah, changing relationship with bestie Lee and feelings for a new classmate.
tagline: Rules can be broken...but so can hearts.
title: The Kissing Booth 2
plot:
The Kissing Booth 2 is a 2020 American teen romantic comedy directed by Vince Marcello, who co-wrote the screenplay with Jay Arnold. A direct sequel to The Kissing Booth (2018) and the second film in a trilogy based on Beth Reekles's novels, it stars Joey King, Joel Courtney and Jacob Elordi, with Molly Ringwald and newcomer Taylor Zakhar Perez in supporting roles. Netflix released it on July 24, 2020.

Elle Evans begins her senior year of high school amid gossip that she and her boyfriend Noah, now a freshman at Harvard, are about to split up. Her insecurity deepens when she sees Noah becoming friendly on social media with Chloe, a glamorous British classmate. Meanwhile, Elle and her best friend Lee plan to revive their kissing booth for the school's charity carnival, and Elle persuades Marco Peña, a charming new transfer student, to take part after beating him at a dance video game. Noah encourages Elle to apply to Harvard, which conflicts with her lifelong plan to attend Berkeley with Lee, where their mothers first met, so she applies in secret. Worried about tuition, she also enters a dance competition with Lee to win a large cash prize.

A visit to Noah in Boston leaves Elle more anxious after she meets Chloe and finds an earring under his bed. When Lee fakes an injury, Marco becomes Elle's dance partner, and the two grow increasingly attracted to each other. At the same time, Lee's relationship with his girlfriend Rachel suffers because Elle is always with them. After Elle kisses Marco at the end of their winning performance, unaware that Noah is watching, tensions explode at Thanksgiving: Noah brings Chloe, Lee discovers Elle's secret Harvard application, and Rachel breaks up with Lee. Elle learns that the earring was innocently lost, and at the carnival Lee and Rachel reconcile at the kissing booth. Elle admits to Marco that they share chemistry but tells him she loves Noah, and she reconciles with Noah before he returns east. The film ends with Elle accepted into both Harvard and Berkeley, her decision left unresolved.

Like its predecessor, the film received generally negative reviews, although some critics found it less problematic than the first film. The Independent gave it two stars out of five, while The Detroit News called it a sun-kissed fantasy with an appealing cast. A third film, The Kissing Booth 3, was released on August 11, 2021.

original_title: Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets
overview: In the 28th century, Valerian and Laureline are special operatives charged with keeping order throughout the human territories. On assignment from the Minister of Defense, the two undertake a mission to Alpha, an ever-expanding metropolis where species from across the universe have converged over centuries to share knowledge, intelligence, and cultures. At the center of Alpha is a mysterious dark force which threatens the peaceful existence of the City of a Thousand Planets, and Valerian and Laureline must race to identify the menace and safeguard not just Alpha, but the future of the universe.
tagline: A universe without boundaries needs heroes without limits.
title: Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets
plot:
Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets is a science fiction film directed by Luc Besson, based on the French comic book series "Valérian et la Cité des Mille Planètes" created by Pierre Christin and Jean-Claude Mézières. The movie was produced by TF1 Films Production.

The story begins in 2045, where we meet our protagonists, Major Valerian (Dane DeHaan) and Captain Laureline (Cara Delevingne), two space agents working for the Galactic Federation. They are tasked with investigating a mysterious threat to the universe, known as the "Dark Matter," which is causing chaos throughout the cosmos.

The duo embarks on a perilous journey through time and space, visiting various planets and encountering strange creatures along the way. Their quest takes them to the City of a Thousand Planets, a mystical metropolis that exists outside of time and space. The city is home to an ancient civilization known as the "Alpha," who possess knowledge and power beyond human comprehension.

As Valerian and Laureline delve deeper into the heart of the city, they discover that the Dark Matter is actually a manifestation of their own past traumas and fears. They must confront their personal demons and work together to overcome their differences in order to save the universe from destruction.

Throughout their journey, the two agents encounter various allies and enemies, including the enigmatic and seductive Arun (Rafael Amaya), who becomes a key player in their quest. The duo also discovers that they are not just ordinary space agents, but rather reincarnated souls from ancient civilizations, tasked with preserving the balance of the universe.

As the stakes grow higher, Valerian and Laureline find themselves facing off against the mastermind behind the Dark Matter: the Timekeeper (Eugene Byrd), a powerful being who seeks to destroy the fabric of time itself. The final battle takes place in the heart of the City of a Thousand Planets, where our heroes must use all their skills and knowledge to defeat the Timekeeper and restore balance to the universe.

In the end, Valerian and Laureline succeed in defeating the Timekeeper, but not without sacrifices. They realize that they have been given a second chance at life, and that their love for each other is the key to unlocking their true potential. The movie concludes with the two agents standing together, ready to face whatever challenges the universe may throw their way.

Overall, Valerian and the City of a Thousand Planets is a visually stunning and action-packed sci-fi adventure that explores themes of love, sacrifice, and redemption. With its intricate plot and memorable characters, it's no wonder this movie has become a cult classic among fans of science fiction.

overview: And suddenly, overnight, the world came to a halt. Two men, two survivors, one kid, and hatred that separates them. A place forgotten by everyone, including the creatures that inhabit the Earth... until now.
tagline: When the undead can evolve, no one is safe.
title: Extinction
plot:
Extinction is a 2015 science fiction action film directed by Michael J. Bassett and starring Nicolas Cage, Olivia Wilde, and Holt McCallany.

The movie follows a former soldier, Will Cutter (Nicolas Cage), who is struggling to cope with the loss of his wife and daughter in a catastrophic event that has devastated the world. As he tries to rebuild his life, he discovers that his daughter, Sam (Mackenzie Foy), has been infected by an alien parasite that slowly transforms her into a monstrous creature.

The main themes of Extinction include:

1. Grief and Loss: The film explores Will's emotional struggle to come to terms with the loss of his loved ones and his inability to protect them from the alien threat.
2. Fatherhood: Will's love for his daughter is a central theme, as he tries to find a way to save her from the parasite that is slowly taking over her body.
3. Survival: As the world around him descends into chaos, Will must fight to survive and protect himself and those he cares about from the alien threat.
4. Sacrifice: Throughout the film, Will is forced to make difficult choices and sacrifices in order to save his daughter and potentially humanity.

The movie's plot is driven by these themes, as Will navigates a desperate bid to find a cure for the parasite and save his daughter before it's too late.

Overall, Extinction is a tense and emotional sci-fi thriller that explores the complexities of human relationships and the lengths people will go to protect those they love.

overview: A retired legal counselor writes a novel hoping to find closure for one of his past unresolved homicide cases and for his unreciprocated love with his superior - both of which still haunt him decades later.
title: The Secret in Their Eyes
plot:
The Secret in Their Eyes is a thought-provoking and emotionally charged film that delves into the complexities of human nature, justice, and the blurred lines between right and wrong. At its core, the movie explores the theme of obsession, as embodied by the protagonist, Benjamín Esposito, a retired detective who becomes fixated on solving a decades-old murder case.

As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Esposito's fixation is not just about solving the crime, but also about confronting his own personal demons and seeking redemption. His obsession serves as a metaphor for the human desire to make sense of chaos and to find justice in a seemingly unjust world.

The film also delves into the theme of nostalgia, as Esposito's past and present begin to intersect in unexpected ways. The movie's use of non-linear storytelling adds to this sense of nostalgia, creating a sense of timelessness that underscores the enduring power of human emotions.

Furthermore, The Secret in Their Eyes raises important questions about the nature of justice and morality. As Esposito becomes increasingly consumed by his investigation, he begins to question whether his pursuit of truth is driven by a desire for justice or simply a need for validation. This internal conflict serves as a powerful commentary on the complexities of human motivation and the gray areas that often separate right from wrong.

Ultimately, The Secret in Their Eyes is a movie about the human condition, with all its attendant complexities and contradictions. It is a thought-provoking exploration of the darker aspects of human nature, and the ways in which our desires, obsessions, and motivations can both define and destroy us.

overview: A bored and domesticated Shrek pacts with deal-maker Rumpelstiltskin to get back to feeling like a real ogre again, but when he's duped and sent to a twisted version of Far Far Away—where Rumpelstiltskin is king, ogres are hunted, and he and Fiona have never met—he sets out to restore his world and reclaim his true love.
tagline: It ain't Ogre... Til it's Ogre
title: Shrek Forever After
plot:
Shrek Forever After is a 2010 animated fantasy comedy film directed by Mike Mitchell, produced by DreamWorks Animation, and based on the Shrek franchise. The movie takes place after the events of Shrek the Third.

The story begins with Shrek (Mike Myers) feeling unappreciated and overworked as an ogre. He is constantly surrounded by fairy tale creatures, including Donkey (Eddie Murphy), who never shuts up. Shrek longs for a simpler life, free from his royal duties and responsibilities. One day, while sitting in a swampy bar with Donkey, Shrek meets Rumpelstiltskin (Conrad Vernon), a mischievous imp who offers him a deal: if Shrek signs the charter of his kingdom over to Rumpelstiltskin for one day, he will be granted any wish he desires.

Shrek, tempted by the promise of freedom and adventure, agrees to the deal. However, things don't go as planned. On the designated day, Shrek finds himself in a parallel universe where he is married to Fiona (Cameron Diaz) and has three children with her. He also meets his alternate self, who is a more confident and successful ogre.

As Shrek navigates this new reality, he realizes that being an ogre isn't all it's cracked up to be. His wife and children are not as happy with him as they seem, and he begins to question the choices he made in his life. Meanwhile, Rumpelstiltskin is using Shrek's kingdom to gain power and control over both worlds.

Shrek must find a way to return to his own world and break the curse that has been cast upon him. Along the way, he teams up with Donkey, who has also become trapped in this parallel universe. Together, they embark on a perilous journey to rescue Shrek's family and restore balance to both worlds.

Throughout the movie, the characters face various challenges and obstacles, including the villainous Rumpelstiltskin and his minions. The film features plenty of humor, action, and heartwarming moments as Shrek learns valuable lessons about being true to oneself and appreciating what one has.

Overall, Shrek Forever After is a fun and entertaining addition to the Shrek franchise, with plenty of twists and turns to keep viewers engaged until the very end.

overview: Wayne gets a new rookie partner, Lanny, after his previous partner got the promotion he wanted. Lanny has to remind Wayne of the Spirit of Christmas and the importance of being an elf in Santa's Prep and Landing elite unit.
tagline: No one does stealth like an Elf.
title: Prep & Landing
plot:
Prep & Landing is an American computer-animated Christmas television special produced by Walt Disney Animation Studios. Based on an idea by Chris Williams and developed into a half-hour special by Kevin Deters and Stevie Wermers-Skelton, it premiered on ABC on December 8, 2009, a week later than planned. Dave Foley voices the veteran elf Wayne and Derek Richardson his rookie partner Lanny, with Sarah Chalke, David DeLuise and Mason Vale Cotton in the cast. It launched a small franchise of follow-up shorts and specials.

Behind Santa Claus's yearly journey stands Prep & Landing, an elite unit of elves who slip into homes around the world ahead of the sleigh and make sure everything is ready for his arrival. Wayne has served with the outfit for 227 years and fully expects to be rewarded with a promotion to director of the naughty list. To his dismay, the post goes to Peterson, his own former trainee and partner, and Wayne is instead saddled with Lanny, an eager young recruit fresh out of training.

Resentful about being passed over, Wayne decides to coast through the night's assignment, the home of a young boy named Timmy. He leaves the enthusiastic but inexperienced Lanny to handle everything on his own, and the preparations quickly go wrong. While Santa is in the air, the North Pole learns that a heavy snowstorm is closing in and that the house has not been properly prepared. Santa is advised to skip the stop altogether, something that has never happened before, and the elves are told that Timmy will simply be compensated later.

When the two elves learn that the decision to reroute the sleigh is final, Wayne at first accepts it. Then he hears Timmy murmur his thanks in his sleep, and his holiday spirit returns. He contacts Santa directly and insists that the sleigh must land at Timmy's house after all. Working together at last, Wayne and Lanny guide Santa through the storm and onto the roof so the presents can be delivered.

On Christmas morning, Santa shows Wayne that Timmy is enjoying a happy Christmas, and offers him a promotion to director of the nice list. Wayne declines, choosing to remain in the field with Lanny. The special was released on DVD in 2011 together with later shorts, and was followed by the shorts Operation: Secret Santa (2010) and the special Naughty vs. Nice (2011).

overview: When a retired Green Beret soldier is murdered by an Albanian drug gang in London, four of his veteran SAS comrades set out to avenge him, dispensing their own brand of justice on the streets of London.
tagline: Armed for war and out for justice.
title: Renegades
plot:
Renegades is a 2022 British crime action thriller directed by Daniel Zirilli and produced by Shogun Films. Built around a cast of veteran actors, it stars Nick Moran as Carl Burton, Lee Majors as Major Carver, Ian Ogilvy as Major Frederick Peck, Billy Murray as Major George "Woody" Woodward and Paul Barber as Sergeant Robert Harris, alongside Danny Trejo as Sanchez, Patsy Kensit as Judy Carver, Louis Mandylor as Anthony Goram, Michael Paré as CIA agent Donovan, Stephanie Beacham as Hartigan and Jeanine Nerissa Sothcott as Detective Moore, with Tom Lister Jr. and Michael Brandon.

Burton is a low-profile former SAS soldier suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder. He is picked up on the street by an old acquaintance, the American veteran and retired Green Beret Carver, who has a grudge against a gang of criminals in his London neighborhood that is trafficking women and dealing drugs. When Carver's attempt to deal with the gangsters fails and he is murdered by them, Burton and three of his old SAS comrades, Peck, Woodward and Harris, band together to avenge their friend, dispensing their own brand of justice on the streets of London. Along the way they receive help from Sanchez, a friendly gangster, from Carver's daughter Judy, a politician, and from a few police officers, in a campaign marked by gory shootouts and explosions.

The film was shot in London, wrapping in October 2021, and the filmmakers cited Harry Brown and The Wild Geese as influences. It was released for streaming in the United Kingdom on 1 October 2022 and on digital platforms in January 2023. Reviews were mixed. In The Guardian, Leslie Felperin gave it two stars out of five, describing a cheap thriller that belatedly cashes in on the "geri-action" trend of films like Red and The Expendables, with inept, low-energy action and stilted dialogue that she likened to the output of an AI chatbot. Other reviewers were kinder: IndieWrap called it highly engaging and spectacularly entertaining, Chris Ward enjoyed it as a mash-up of The Expendables, Death Wish and Cockney gangster movies, and Jim McLellan gave it a B-minus, placing it between the serious Harry Brown and the silly Cockneys vs Zombies and finding Guy Ritchie's influence palpable, while singling out Ogilvy's charm.

overview: This prequel of the bone-chilling Tremors begins in the town of Rejection, Nev., in 1889, where 17 men die under mysterious circumstances. Spooked by recent events, the miners who populate the town leave in droves until there's nothing left but a shell of a community. It's up to the remaining residents to get to the bottom of the deaths -- but they must do so before they, too, are eradicated off the face of the planet.
tagline: A Revolution Has Begun...
title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
plot:
Tremors 4: The Legend Begins is an action-adventure film that delves into the origins of the Graboid legend, exploring the early days of Valentine McKee's life and his encounters with these monstrous creatures. 

The movie primarily revolves around themes of isolation, survival, and the power of human ingenuity in the face of unimaginable danger. The story takes place in a remote desert town where Valentine McKee (played by Christopher Gartin) is trying to make a living as a mechanic. However, his peaceful life is disrupted when he encounters Graboids for the first time.

As Valentine navigates this new threat, he must confront his own vulnerabilities and learn to rely on himself and others in order to survive. The film also touches upon themes of community and the importance of forming alliances in times of crisis. Through Valentine's journey, the movie showcases the resilience of the human spirit and its capacity for growth and adaptation.

The Legend Begins is a thrilling adventure that not only pays homage to the original Tremors series but also offers an engaging origin story that expands on the Graboid mythology.

overview: While driving through the New Mexico Desert during a rainy night, the college students Jim Halsey and his girlfriend Grace Andrews give a ride to the hitchhiker John Ryder. While in their car, the stranger proves to be a psychopath threatening the young couple with a knife, but Jim succeeds to throw him out of the car on the road. On the next morning, the young couple sees John in another car.
tagline: Never pick up strangers.
title: The Hitcher
plot:
The Hitcher is a 2007 American road horror thriller directed by Dave Meyers in his feature debut and produced by Michael Bay's company Platinum Dunes. Sean Bean stars as the murderous hitchhiker John Ryder, with Sophia Bush and Zachary Knighton as the young couple he torments, and Neal McDonough and Kyle Davis in supporting roles. It is a remake of the 1986 film of the same title, which starred Rutger Hauer, C. Thomas Howell and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

College students Jim Halsey and his girlfriend Grace Andrews are driving across New Mexico to meet friends for spring break. On their first night on the road, they nearly run over a man standing in the middle of the highway in a rainstorm, and Grace persuades Jim to drive on rather than stop. Later, at a gas station, they meet the same man, who introduces himself as John Ryder and asks for a ride. Jim reluctantly agrees, and Ryder soon turns violent, holding a knife to Grace's eye and telling Jim that the only way to save them is to say, "I want to die." Jim manages to throw him out of the moving car.

The next day, Jim and Grace see Ryder riding in a family's car and try to warn them, but crash their own vehicle. When they find the family's car abandoned, the parents and children have been slaughtered. Ryder begins a game of cat and mouse with the couple, framing them for his killings so that they are pursued by the police as well as by him. Taken into custody, they are unable to convince Lieutenant Esteridge of their innocence, and the violence grows as Ryder murders officers and anyone else who stands between him and his chosen victims. Grace, who begins as the more frightened of the pair, is forced to become increasingly resourceful and determined as the ordeal moves toward a final confrontation on a desert highway.

The Hitcher was released by Rogue Pictures in January 2007 and grossed about $25 million worldwide. It received largely negative reviews; critics considered it an unnecessary remake that replaced the original's ambiguity and menace with conventional gore and action, though some found Bean an effectively sinister presence.

overview: The hidden memoir of an elderly woman confined to a mental hospital reveals the history of her passionate yet tortured life, and of the religious and political upheavals in Ireland during the 1920s and 30s.
title: The Secret Scripture
plot:
The Secret Scripture is a 2016 Irish drama film directed by Jim Sheridan, not 2017, and produced by Ferndale Films. 

The movie revolves around Roseanne McNulty, an elderly woman who writes her life story in the form of a novel called "The Secret Scripture". The story follows Roseanne's experiences in a psychiatric hospital where she was a patient for over 40 years, as well as her tumultuous relationship with her husband and her struggles to maintain her identity.

At its core, The Secret Scripture explores themes of identity, self-discovery, and the power of storytelling. Through Roseanne's narrative, the film delves into the complexities of human experience, revealing the inner workings of a mind that has been shaped by trauma, love, and loss. As the story unfolds, it becomes clear that Roseanne's experiences are not just her own, but also those of countless women who have been silenced, marginalized, or oppressed throughout history.

The film is also a poignant exploration of the human condition, touching on themes of loneliness, isolation, and the search for meaning in a world that often seems cruel and unforgiving. Through Roseanne's character, Sheridan sheds light on the experiences of women who have been forced to navigate a patriarchal society that seeks to control and silence them.

Ultimately, The Secret Scripture is a powerful exploration of the human spirit, one that celebrates the resilience of the human heart in the face of adversity and the transformative power of storytelling.

overview: While in his teens, Donny fathered a son, Todd, and raised him as a single parent up until Todd's 18th birthday. Now, after not seeing each other for years, Todd's world comes crashing down when Donny resurfaces just before Todd's wedding.
tagline: The story of a child… and his son.
title: That's My Boy
plot:
That's My Boy is a 2012 American comedy film directed by Dennis Dugan and starring Adam Sandler, Andy Samberg, and Lea Michele. The movie follows the story of Donny Berger (Adam Sandler), a 39-year-old slacker who has never grown up.

The film begins with Donny's high school reunion, where he is still living in his parents' basement. His father, Sid (Dennis Dugan), is a successful businessman, and his mother, Mary (Joyce Van Patten), is a kind-hearted woman who always tries to help her son. However, Donny's laziness and lack of ambition have made him a disappointment to his family.

Donny's life takes an unexpected turn when he meets a young woman named Molly (Lea Michele), who is the daughter of Sid's business partner, Kurt (Kevin James). Molly is a beautiful and charming woman who has just graduated from college and is looking for a job. Donny, being the ladies' man that he thinks he is, tries to impress her with his fake stories about his accomplishments.

As Donny spends more time with Molly, he begins to develop real feelings for her. However, their relationship is put to the test when Donny's past comes back to haunt him. His high school sweetheart, Charlotte (Vanessa Bayer), returns and reveals that she has been in love with Donny all along. Donny must choose between his old life and a new one with Molly.

Meanwhile, Sid is dealing with his own problems. He is struggling to find a suitable partner for Kurt's daughter, and he becomes increasingly frustrated with Donny's lack of motivation. The two men engage in a series of comedic battles, with Donny trying to prove himself as a capable adult.

As the story unfolds, Donny must confront his past mistakes and learn to take responsibility for his life. With the help of Molly and his family, he begins to grow up and become a better person. In the end, Donny realizes that he has found true love with Molly and decides to leave his old life behind.

The movie ends on a positive note, with Donny and Molly starting a new life together. Sid finally finds a suitable partner for Kurt's daughter, and Donny's family is happy to see him grow up. The film concludes with a heartwarming moment of Donny and Molly sharing a kiss, symbolizing their love and commitment to each other.

Overall, That's My Boy is a lighthearted comedy that explores themes of growing up, love, and redemption. With its talented cast and witty dialogue, the movie provides an entertaining ride for audiences.

overview: An uptight by-the-book cop must protect the widow of a drug boss from crooked cops and gunmen.
tagline: Armed and Sort-of Dangerous.
title: Hot Pursuit
plot:
Hot Pursuit is a 2015 American action comedy directed by Anne Fletcher from a screenplay by David Feeney and John Quaintance. Produced by New Line Cinema, Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer Pictures and Reese Witherspoon's company Pacific Standard, and distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures, it stars Witherspoon as a by-the-book police officer and Sofía Vergara as the outspoken widow she is assigned to protect. The film was released in cinemas on 8 May 2015.

Rose Cooper is a San Antonio police officer whose rigid devotion to the rules has made her a laughing stock. After an embarrassing incident in which she sets the mayor's son on fire with her taser, she is relegated to working in the evidence room. Her captain offers her a chance to redeem herself by joining a U.S. Marshal on a protection detail: Felipe Riva and his wife Daniella are to be escorted to Dallas so that Felipe can testify against the cartel boss Vicente Cortez.

At the Rivas' house, two separate teams of gunmen attack, killing the marshal and Felipe while Cooper and Daniella are upstairs. The two women flee in the Rivas' car, with Daniella insisting on bringing a suitcase full of shoes. When Daniella tries to escape, Cooper handcuffs herself to her. They are soon found by two fellow police officers, and Cooper realises from a tattoo that they are among the assassins, meaning that corrupt police are involved. The unlikely pair head for Dallas while being pursued by both crooked officers and cartel hitmen, only to learn that Cooper has been branded a fugitive. Along the way they survive a collision with a truck carrying cocaine, disguise themselves in increasingly absurd ways and gradually begin to trust one another, as Cooper discovers that the case is more complicated than she was told and that Daniella has secrets of her own.

The film follows the buddy-cop formula, built around the contrast between the uptight, diminutive Cooper and the glamorous, quick-tempered Daniella, with much of its humour derived from physical comedy and the bickering between its two leads.

Hot Pursuit was poorly received by critics, with an approval rating of about 8 percent on Rotten Tomatoes, as reviewers found its jokes tired and its plot predictable despite the efforts of its stars. It grossed about 51.4 million dollars worldwide against a budget of 35 million.

overview: The US President and the UK Prime Minister are planning on launching a war in the Middle East, but—behind the scenes—government officials and advisers are either promoting the war or are trying to prevent it.
tagline: The fate of the world is on the line.
title: In the Loop
plot:
In the Loop is a satirical comedy that delves into the complexities and absurdities of politics, bureaucracy, and human relationships. The film masterfully weaves together multiple storylines to expose the flaws in the decision-making process, particularly in the context of war and foreign policy.

At its core, In the Loop critiques the notion of "looping" – a bureaucratic term that refers to the repetitive and often pointless nature of administrative processes. The movie highlights how this can lead to a lack of accountability, inefficiency, and a general disregard for human life. Through the characters' interactions, the film illustrates how even well-intentioned individuals can become mired in the complexities of politics, leading to a sense of detachment and moral ambiguity.

The film also explores themes of power dynamics, with characters navigating their roles within the government and military hierarchies. The satire is biting, particularly when it comes to the way politicians and bureaucrats use jargon and technical terms to obscure the truth from the public.

Furthermore, In the Loop touches on the human cost of war and the consequences of making decisions without fully considering the repercussions. The characters' relationships with each other are often strained, revealing a deeper sense of vulnerability and emotional complexity beneath their professional facades.

Overall, In the Loop is a thought-provoking comedy that uses humor to highlight the absurdities and pitfalls of politics, bureaucracy, and human relationships in the context of war and foreign policy.

overview: When El, an aspiring sneaker designer from Queens, meets Kira King, the fiercely independent daughter of legendary basketball star and sneaker tycoon Darius King, sparks fly as the two bond over their mutual affinity for sneakers. With a little nudge from his best friend and a sprinkle of Fairy Godfather magic, El finds the courage to use his talent to pursue his dream of becoming a ‘legit’ sneaker designer in the industry.
tagline: Lace up and dream.
title: Sneakerella
plot:
Sneakerella is a 2022 American romantic comedy film produced by Walt Disney Pictures. The movie is loosely based on Cinderella.

The main theme of Sneakerella revolves around self-discovery, empowerment, and the importance of staying true to oneself. The protagonist, Ella, played by Chloe East, is a young woman who dreams of becoming a professional sneaker designer but faces obstacles due to her humble background.

As Ella navigates her way through life, she learns valuable lessons about perseverance, friendship, and believing in herself. She also discovers that being different doesn't make someone any less worthy or deserving of happiness.

The film explores the idea of identity and how it can be shaped by societal expectations versus personal aspirations. Through Ella's journey, the movie promotes a positive message about embracing one's uniqueness and pursuing their passions, even if they may not align with traditional norms.

Additionally, Sneakerella touches on themes of classism, social inequality, and the importance of education and hard work in achieving success. The film also features a strong supporting cast, including Will Swenson as Ella's love interest, and showcases a blend of humor, heart, and style that is characteristic of Disney movies.

Overall, Sneakerella offers an uplifting and inspiring story about finding one's place in the world and staying true to oneself, making it a delightful watch for audiences of all ages.

overview: When the son of a successful judge is killed by two police officers and the system sets them free, a hardened veteran detective finds some incriminating files on the officers and the judge teams up with another mourning father to take the law into his own hands.
tagline: Vengeance is the Only Justice
title: River Runs Red
plot:
River Runs Red is a 2018 American crime thriller written and directed by Wes Miller. Taye Diggs stars as Judge Charles Coleman Jr., with John Cusack, George Lopez, Luke Hemsworth and Gianni Capaldi in supporting roles. The film is a revenge drama about a judge who loses faith in the legal system after his son is killed by police officers, and it addresses themes of racism, police violence and the limits of justice.

The film opens with a flashback in which Charles's father, also a judge, teaches his young son about standing up for principle, citing the example of Muhammad Ali. As an adult, Charles has become a respected judge and one of the few prominent Black legal figures in his city. He lives with his wife Marilyn and their son CJ, who is about to begin training at the police academy. Charles believes deeply in the law and has built his life around it.

On his way to his first day at the academy, CJ crosses paths with two police officers, Rory and Von. Rory, a hot-tempered racist, mistakes a harmless gesture from CJ for an insult and pulls him over. During the tense traffic stop, he wrongly believes CJ is reaching for a weapon and opens fire, and both officers shoot. CJ is killed, and when the officers realize he was unarmed, they plant a gun in his car to justify the shooting. An investigation clears them, leaving Charles devastated and his faith in the system shattered. With quiet help from Horace, an older detective who respects him, Charles uncovers a pattern of earlier suspicious shootings by the same officers that city officials have ignored. His inquiry leads him to Javier, a father whose son was killed by the pair years before, and when the mayor and other leaders refuse to act on their evidence, the two grieving fathers decide to take justice into their own hands, setting off a chain of violence and a manhunt.

The film was released in limited theaters and on demand in November 2018. It received generally negative reviews, with critics acknowledging its timely subject but faulting its script and execution.

overview: A fish-out-of-water comedy about a talented street drummer from Harlem who enrolls in a Southern university, expecting to lead its marching band's drumline to victory. He initially flounders in his new world, before realizing that it takes more than talent to reach the top.
tagline: Half time is game time
title: Drumline
plot:
Drumline is a 2002 American musical drama film directed by Doug McHenry. The movie follows the story of Devon Miles (played by Nick Cannon), a young and talented drummer who joins the historically black college drumline at Atlanta's Morehouse College.

The main themes of Drumline include:

1. Perseverance and determination: Devon's journey is marked by his unwavering dedication to perfecting his craft, despite facing numerous setbacks and rejections.
2. Self-discovery and identity: As Devon navigates the complexities of college life, he must also confront his own identity and find his place within the world.
3. Friendship and camaraderie: The drumline serves as a tight-knit community for Devon and his fellow members, who support each other through thick and thin.
4. Overcoming adversity: The film showcases the challenges faced by African American students at historically black colleges, including racism, stereotypes, and academic pressures.
5. Passion and creativity: Drumming is portrayed as a source of joy, expression, and empowerment for Devon and his fellow drummers.

Throughout the movie, these themes are woven together to create a narrative that celebrates the power of music, friendship, and perseverance in overcoming adversity.

overview: A seemingly bright and mostly innocent 16-year-old named Mo attempts to navigate high school under the guidance of his best friend Zeke, an unmotivated-yet-charismatic college dropout. Although Zeke genuinely cares about Mo, things start to go awry as he teaches Mo nontraditional life lessons in drug dealing, partying, and dating. Meanwhile, Mo’s well-meaning dad tries to step in and take back the reins of his son’s upbringing.
tagline: Under his influence.
title: Big Time Adolescence
plot:
Big Time Adolescence is a 2020 coming-of-age comedy-drama film that explores the complexities and challenges of adolescence through the eyes of its protagonist, Luke. The movie delves into themes of identity, self-discovery, and the struggles of growing up.

At its core, Big Time Adolescence is a poignant portrayal of the tumultuous teenage years, where characters are navigating their way through relationships, peer pressure, and the quest for independence. The film masterfully captures the anxiety, uncertainty, and vulnerability that often accompany this pivotal stage of life.

One of the primary themes of the movie is the exploration of toxic masculinity and its effects on young men. Luke's character, in particular, grapples with traditional masculine norms and expectations, leading to a series of awkward and humorous misadventures. The film cleverly subverts these stereotypes, offering a nuanced and empathetic portrayal of a generation often misunderstood.

The movie also touches on the theme of friendship and loyalty, highlighting the importance of supportive relationships during times of turmoil. Luke's friendships with his peers serve as a source of comfort, validation, and inspiration, illustrating the significance of human connections in navigating life's challenges.

Furthermore, Big Time Adolescence tackles the complexities of social media and its impact on self-perception and identity formation. The film critiques the curated online personas that often mask the true selves of young people, emphasizing the need for authenticity and vulnerability in building meaningful relationships.

Ultimately, Big Time Adolescence is a heartfelt and humorous exploration of the adolescent experience, offering a relatable and authentic portrayal of the challenges and triumphs that come with growing up.

overview: A young girl turns into an A-List celebrity over night when her private journal is accidently published and becomes a best-seller.
title: Read It and Weep
plot:
Read It and Weep is a 2006 American comedy-drama Disney Channel Original Movie, which premiered on July 21, 2006. Based on Julia DeVillers's novel How My Private, Personal Journal Became a Bestseller, it stars real-life sisters Kay Panabaker as the ninth-grader Jamie Bartlett and Danielle Panabaker as Isabella, or "Is", the confident heroine of Jamie's imagination. Jason Dolley, Alexandra Krosney, Allison Scagliotti, Nick Whitaker and Robin Riker co-star, and DeVillers makes a cameo in a pizza parlour scene.

Jamie is a freshman with three close friends, Connor, Lindsay and Harmony, a brother named Lenny, and a rival, the popular Sawyer Sullivan, whose boyfriend Marco Vega is Jamie's crush. On her tablet computer she keeps a daily journal starring Is, a glamorous girl with remarkable powers who stands up to a nasty classmate named Myrna. The stories are a fanciful version of Jamie's own life, and Myrna is clearly modelled on Sawyer. When her printer breaks on the day an English essay is due, Jamie emails the file to Lindsay to print, but sends the journal by mistake. Lindsay hands it in, the journal wins a writing contest, and it is published as a novel.

The book becomes a bestseller and Jamie a celebrity, touring signings and talk shows and meeting stars she has long admired. Fame goes to her head: she grows materialistic and dismissive, quits her job at her father's struggling pizza restaurant, mocks Lenny's guitar playing and neglects her friends. During a television interview she lets slip that the villain is based on Sawyer and that the book draws on real school dramas, and her classmates turn against her, hurt by what she has written about them.

Shunned by her friends, Jamie sets out to repair the damage. She apologises to Lenny and encourages him to play again, learns that her parents may have to close the restaurant, and finally confronts Is, telling her imaginary alter ego to stop steering her life. At the ocean-themed school dance her classmates gradually accept that the journal was never meant to be published. Jamie discovers that the poems she admired in class were written by Connor, not Marco, and the two share a kiss while Lenny performs a song for her. Afterwards a mishap with seaweed on the restaurant's pizzas proves a hit with customers, giving the family business a way to survive.

overview: A group of male friends become obsessed with five mysterious sisters who are sheltered by their strict, religious parents.
tagline: Beautiful, mysterious, haunting, invariably fatal. Just like life.
title: The Virgin Suicides
plot:
The Virgin Suicides is a 1999 film directed by Sofia Coppola, produced by American Zoetrope, and written by Coppola.

The main themes of The Virgin Suicides revolve around the lives of five sisters - Lux, Bonnie, Mary, Therese, and Cecilia Lisbon - who are struggling to find their place in the world. The story is set in 1970s suburban America, where the family's patriarch, Mr. Lisbon, has died, leaving his wife, Mrs. Lisbon, to raise the girls on her own.

The film explores several themes:

1. **Isolation and Loneliness**: The sisters are trapped in their gilded cage of a suburban home, with limited freedom and social interaction. This isolation leads to feelings of loneliness, disconnection, and desperation.
2. **Female Identity and Agency**: The movie delves into the struggles of women's roles in society, particularly during the 1970s. The sisters are expected to conform to traditional feminine norms, but they yearn for independence, autonomy, and self-expression.
3. **Mental Health and Trauma**: The film touches on the themes of mental health, depression, and trauma, as the sisters struggle with their own emotional pain and the weight of their family's expectations.
4. **Social Pressures and Conformity**: The movie critiques the societal pressures that force individuals to conform to certain norms, particularly for women. The Lisbon sisters are expected to maintain a perfect facade, hiding their true selves from the world.
5. **The Power of Observation**: The film highlights the importance of observation in understanding human behavior. The boys who become infatuated with the sisters serve as observers, influencing their lives and ultimately contributing to their downfall.

Throughout the film, Coppola masterfully weaves these themes together, creating a poignant and thought-provoking exploration of the complexities of female experience, suburban life, and the struggles of adolescence.

The ending is particularly haunting, leaving the audience with a sense of sadness, loss, and regret. The final scene, where the sisters' deaths are revealed through a series of newspaper clippings, serves as a powerful commentary on the societal pressures that can lead to tragic consequences.

Overall, The Virgin Suicides is a masterful film that explores the intricacies of human emotions, relationships, and the struggles of growing up in a society that often seeks to constrain individuality.

overview: Movie star Vincent Chase, together with his boys, Eric, Turtle and Johnny, are back…and back in business with super agent-turned-studio head Ari Gold. Some of their ambitions have changed, but the bond between them remains strong as they navigate the capricious and often cutthroat world of Hollywood.
tagline: Dream large. Live larger.
title: Entourage
plot:
Entourage is a 2015 American satirical comedy-drama film written, directed and produced by Doug Ellin as a continuation of the HBO television series he created, which ran from 2004 to 2011. The film reunites the show's principal cast: Adrian Grenier as the movie star Vincent Chase, Kevin Connolly as his manager and best friend Eric "E" Murphy, Kevin Dillon as Vince's brother Johnny "Drama" Chase, Jerry Ferrara as Turtle and Jeremy Piven as Ari Gold. Haley Joel Osment and Billy Bob Thornton play new characters, and as in the series, many celebrities appear as themselves.

The film picks up shortly after the series finale. Vince's marriage has quickly ended, and he and his friends gather on a yacht to cheer him up. Ari, who has given up being an agent to become head of a film studio, offers Vince the lead in his first production, a futuristic take on Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde called Hyde. Vince agrees on the condition that he can direct it, with Drama in a supporting role.

Eight months later the film is in post-production and badly over budget, and Vince needs another $10 million to finish it. Ari flies to Texas to persuade the film's co-financiers, the wealthy Larsen McCredle and his son Travis, to provide more money. Travis travels to Los Angeles to see a cut, but Vince, unsure of the result, keeps postponing screenings. When Travis finally watches it, he demands major changes, including cutting Drama's scenes, while also showing a jealous interest in Vince's relationship with the model Emily Ratajkowski. With Ari's career and the film's future at stake, the friends must deal with the financier's escalating demands. Meanwhile E prepares to become a father with his ex-fiancée Sloan while juggling other romantic complications, Turtle pursues the MMA fighter Ronda Rousey, and Drama faces a personal scandal involving a leaked video.

Released by Warner Bros. in June 2015, Entourage received negative reviews from critics, who found it a self-indulgent extension of the series with little appeal beyond its fans, and it was criticized for its treatment of women. It grossed about $49 million worldwide against a budget of roughly $30 million, a disappointing result for a franchise continuation.

overview: Thomas and his fellow Gladers face their greatest challenge yet: searching for clues about the mysterious and powerful organization known as WCKD. Their journey takes them to the Scorch, a desolate landscape filled with unimaginable obstacles. Teaming up with resistance fighters, the Gladers take on WCKD’s vastly superior forces and uncover its shocking plans for them all.
tagline: The Maze Was Just the Beginning.
title: Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials
plot:
Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials is a science fiction adventure film directed by Wes Ball, based on James Dashner's novel of the same name. The movie takes place after the events of the first film and follows Thomas (Dylan O'Brien) as he navigates the treacherous world outside the Glade.

The story begins with Thomas and his friends, including Newt (Thomas Brodie-Sangster), Minho (Kieran Culkin), and Brenda (Rosa Salazar), escaping from the Maze. They are on a mission to find a cure for the Flare, a deadly disease that is spreading rapidly across the world.

As they journey through the Scorch, a desolate wasteland filled with danger and uncertainty, Thomas begins to realize that he has a crucial role to play in the survival of humanity. He also starts to uncover clues about the true nature of the Glade and the organization known as WICKED (World In Catastrophe: Killzone Experiment Department).

The group encounters various obstacles, including rogue factions, infected humans, and treacherous terrain. Along the way, Thomas forms a bond with Teresa (Riley Keough), a young woman who has been infected by the Flare.

As they near their destination, the group discovers that WICKED is behind the creation of the Maze and the Glade. The organization's true intentions are revealed to be sinister, and Thomas must confront the harsh reality of his existence.

The movie culminates in a thrilling showdown between Thomas and the leader of WICKED, Ava Paige (Patricia Clarkson). In a surprising twist, it is revealed that Ava is actually a clone of Teresa, created by WICKED as part of their experiment to create a super-soldier.

In the end, Thomas and his friends successfully escape from WICKED's facility, but not without sacrifices. The movie concludes with Thomas reflecting on the true nature of humanity and the importance of friendship in the face of adversity.

Overall, Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials is an action-packed and suspenseful film that explores themes of survival, loyalty, and the human condition.

overview: A French woman of African descent manages to escape after being arrested in the Dominican Republic. She finds shelter in the most dangerous district of Santo Domingo, where she is taken in by a group of children. By becoming their protégée and maternal figure, she will see her destiny change inexorably.
tagline: A contemporary tale about a different kind of re-encounter between Africa and the Caribbean.
title: Bantú Mama
plot:
Bantú Mama is a 2021 Dominican drama directed by Ivan Herrera from a screenplay he wrote with its star, Clarisse Albrecht. Produced by Herrera, Albrecht, Franmiris Lombert and Nicolas LaMadrid through Point Barre in association with Aurora Dominicana and Basecamp Studio, it was filmed in the Dominican Republic, France and Senegal. Albrecht plays Emma, with Scarlet Reyes as T.I.N.A., Arturo Perez as $hulo and Euris Javiel as Cuki, along with Donis Taveras. The dialogue is in Spanish and French, and the film runs 77 minutes.

Emma, a French woman of African descent, finds welcome peace and color on a trip to the Dominican Republic, far from her gray life in France. Just as she is about to fly home, however, she is arrested for drug trafficking. After tense police interrogations, a fortuitous car accident allows her to escape, and she seeks refuge in one of the most dangerous districts of Santo Domingo. There she is taken in by three siblings who live on their own, since their mother is dead and their father is in prison. Only the youngest, Cuki, retains a childlike whimsy, while his sister T.I.N.A. and brother $hulo have hardened themselves to survive on the streets and keep their father's illicit business going. Hiding in their makeshift household, Emma longs to return home, but as Cuki grows ever more attached to her she becomes their protégée and a maternal figure, and the four form a family built on joy and hope amid the dangers outside. The children are curious about her Bantu heritage and the African diaspora, and she gleefully demonstrates the Maasai jumps Cuki once saw on television, as her destiny changes in unexpected ways.

Bantú Mama premiered at South by Southwest on 16 March 2021, the first Dominican feature selected by the festival. It was chosen as the Dominican Republic's submission for the Academy Award for Best International Feature Film, and Array acquired distribution rights for several English-speaking territories before releasing it on Netflix on 17 November 2022. Critics praised its lyricism. In Variety, Manuel Betancourt called it a quiet achievement and a dreamy treatise on motherhood and motherlands, admiring Sebastián Cabrera Chelin's affectionate cinematography, which he compared to Barry Jenkins's work, and its refusal of drug-mule clichés. Other reviewers lauded the child performances but found the circumstances of Emma's escape and discovery somewhat contrived.

overview: James Reese has a good job as an ambassador's aid in France, but his real passion is a side gig—working in a minor role in the CIA. He would love to be a full-fledged agent and can't believe his luck when he lands an assignment with Charlie Wax. Trigger-happy Charlie soon has James crying for his desk job, but when he learns that the same guys they're trying to catch are after him, James realises that Charlie may be his only hope of survival.
tagline: Two agents. One city. No merci.
title: From Paris with Love
plot:
From Paris with Love is a 2010 action spy film directed by Pierre Morel and starring John Travolta and Jonathan Rhys Meyers.

The main themes of From Paris with Love revolve around:

1. Loyalty: The movie highlights the strong bond between the two main characters, Charlie Wax (John Travolta) and James Reece (Jonathan Rhys Meyers), as they work together to take down a terrorist organization.
2. Sacrifice: Throughout the film, both characters face numerous challenges and are forced to make difficult choices that put their lives at risk. The movie showcases the sacrifices they make for each other and for the greater good.
3. Redemption: Charlie Wax, in particular, is on a mission to redeem himself after being betrayed by his former employer. He sees this assignment as an opportunity to prove himself and earn back his reputation.
4. Cultural differences: The film explores the cultural differences between the United States and France, highlighting the challenges that come with working across international borders.
5. Personal growth: As the story unfolds, both characters undergo significant personal growth, learning to trust each other and themselves in order to overcome their respective demons.

The plot follows Charlie Wax, a former CIA operative who is sent to Paris to work with James Reece, a young French agent. Their mission is to take down a terrorist organization that has infiltrated the city's government. As they navigate the complex web of espionage, they must confront their own personal struggles and learn to trust each other in order to succeed.

The ending of the film is intense and action-packed, with both characters facing off against the terrorists in a thrilling showdown. Ultimately, Charlie Wax emerges victorious, having redeemed himself and found a new sense of purpose.

original_title: The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part
overview: It's been five years since everything was awesome and the citizens are facing a huge new threat: LEGO DUPLO® invaders from outer space, wrecking everything faster than they can rebuild.
tagline: They come in pieces
title: The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part
plot:
The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part is a 2019 animated adventure comedy film directed by Traci C. Harrison and Mike Mitchell, produced by Dan Lin, Phil Lord, Christopher Miller, and Jarrad Paul, and written by Phil Lord, Christopher Miller, and Dan Hageman.

The movie takes place five years after the events of the first film. Emmet Brickowoski (Chris Pratt) is now a "Special" citizen in the Lego world, tasked with maintaining peace and order. However, he soon discovers that the Lego world is under attack by an evil force known as the "Diplomats," who are trying to take over the world.

Emmet teams up with Wyldstyle (Elizabeth Banks), Batman (Will Arnett), Unikitty (Alison Brie), MetalBeard (Nick Offerman), and other heroes from the first film to stop the Diplomats. Along the way, they encounter new characters, including Queen Watevra Wa'Nabi (Tiffany Haddish) and her son King Watevra.

As Emmet navigates this new threat, he also struggles with his own identity and purpose in the Lego world. He begins to question whether being a "Special" citizen is truly fulfilling or if there's more to life than just following orders.

The movie features stunning animation, witty humor, and heartwarming moments as Emmet and his friends work together to save their world from destruction. Along the way, they encounter various obstacles, including treacherous landscapes, treacherous creatures, and even a traitor among their own ranks.

Throughout the film, the characters face numerous challenges that test their courage, loyalty, and friendship. The movie also explores themes of identity, purpose, and the importance of embracing change and uncertainty.

Ultimately, Emmet and his friends succeed in defeating the Diplomats and saving the Lego world. However, the victory comes at a great cost, and Emmet is forced to confront the reality that being a hero is not always easy or straightforward.

The movie ends on a hopeful note, with Emmet and Wyldstyle embracing their new reality as heroes who have saved the day. The film also sets up potential sequels and spin-offs, leaving fans eager for more adventures in the Lego universe.

Overall, The Lego Movie 2: The Second Part is a thrilling adventure that combines stunning animation, witty humor, and heartwarming moments to create an unforgettable cinematic experience.

overview: A woman is involuntarily committed to a mental institution where she is confronted by her greatest fear.
tagline: Is she or isn't she?
title: Unsane
plot:
Unsane is a 2018 American psychological thriller directed by Steven Soderbergh and written by Jonathan Bernstein and James Greer. Claire Foy stars as Sawyer Valentini, with Joshua Leonard as her stalker David Strine, Jay Pharoah as fellow patient Nate Hoffman, and Juno Temple, Aimee Mullins and Amy Irving in supporting roles, while Matt Damon makes a cameo as a detective. Made on a budget of about 1.5 million dollars, the film was shot entirely on an iPhone 7 Plus. It premiered at the Berlin International Film Festival in February 2018 and was released in the United States in March 2018 by Fingerprint Releasing and Bleecker Street.

Sawyer has moved away from Boston to escape a man who has been stalking her, but she remains anxious and traumatised. She consults a counsellor at the Highland Creek Behavioral Center, and, believing she is filling out routine paperwork, signs a consent form that commits her to a locked psychiatric ward for twenty-four hours. When she calls the police, they tell her that nothing can be done because she signed voluntarily. Her panicked reaction to her confinement, including lashing out at a patient and a staff member, leads the facility to extend her stay by a week.

Another patient, Nate, explains that Highland Creek runs a scheme to profit from health insurance: it tricks people into committing themselves, keeps them for as long as their insurance pays, and then declares them cured. Sawyer's situation becomes even more nightmarish when she recognises one of the orderlies as David Strine, her stalker, working under a false name. No one believes her, and David drugs her so that she appears unstable. Her mother comes to rescue her, but is intercepted, and Nate, who has been secretly documenting the facility's abuses with a hidden phone, is also targeted. Sawyer is left to fight for her survival against a man who has obsessively pursued her, while the audience is left to wonder at first whether he is real or a product of her paranoia.

Soderbergh uses the smartphone format to create a claustrophobic, unsettling look, and the film critiques both the treatment of women who report stalking and the exploitation of patients by the private healthcare system.

Unsane received generally positive reviews, with about 80 percent approval on Rotten Tomatoes and particular praise for Foy's performance. It was a commercial success, grossing more than 14 million dollars worldwide.

overview: Over the course of one fateful day, a corrupt businessman and his socialite wife race to save their daughter from a notorious crime lord.
title: Collision
plot:
Collision is a 2022 South African crime thriller film directed by Fabien Martorell and released by Netflix. Set in Johannesburg over two days shortly before Freedom Day, it interweaves several storylines that converge in a deadly traffic accident. The cast includes Langley Kirkwood as Johan Greser, Tessa Jubber as his wife Diane, Zoey Sneedon as their teenage daughter Nicole, Vuyo Dabula as the gangster Bra Sol, Mpho Sebeng as Thando, Siphesihle Vazi as Cecil, Samke Makhoba as Palesa, Pheello Kotelo as her father Dinoko Wiseman and Thamsanqa Booi as Adze.

The film opens with the collision itself: one car carries a dead man on its windscreen and a screaming girl in the boot, and armed men step out of the vehicles. It then rewinds two days. Johan, head of security at a company run by a relative, is entangled in corrupt deals with the feared crime lord Bra Sol, and when one deal is jeopardized he counts on a promotion that instead goes to a black woman, a blow to his racist assumptions. At home his marriage to the socialite Diane is strained, and their rebellious daughter skips school to spend time with her boyfriend Cecil, a singer, and his money-hungry friend Thando. When Nicole is kidnapped by Bra Sol, Johan and Diane race against time to save her, and her fate comes to depend on Cecil and Thando. In a parallel story, Dinoko, a struggling shopkeeper who pays protection money to Bra Sol, loses a lease to the Nigerian immigrant Adze and rallies other locals into xenophobic attacks on foreign-owned businesses, unaware that his daughter Palesa has fallen in love with Adze. The riots knock out traffic lights, setting the stage for the crash that binds the stories together, while subplots touch on bribery, a corrupt mayor and the trafficking of young girls.

Collision premiered on Netflix on 16 June 2022, timed to South Africa's Youth Day. Reception was mixed. Naledi de Wee of The South African praised its exceptional acting, unexpected twists, Ofentse Mwase's cinematography and engagement with racism, xenophobia and human trafficking, comparing it favorably with Netflix's other South African productions. Vivian Nneka Nwajiaku of Afrocritik gave it 2.5 out of 5, likening its structure to Crash but finding the plot scattered, the thrills scarce, the political statements half-hearted and the performances middling apart from Dabula's menacing yet gentle Bra Sol. Other reviewers similarly found it competently shot but confusing and poorly paced.

original_title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
overview: Cheese-loving eccentric Wallace and his cunning canine pal, Gromit, investigate a mystery in Nick Park's animated adventure, in which the lovable inventor and his intrepid pup run a business ridding the town of garden pests. Using only humane methods that turn their home into a halfway house for evicted vermin, the pair stumble upon a mystery involving a voracious vegetarian monster that threatens to ruin the annual veggie-growing contest.
tagline: Something bunny is going on...
title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
plot:
Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit is a stop-motion animated comedy film directed by Nick Park and produced by Aardman Animations. The movie was released in 2005.

In the beginning, Wallace (voiced by Peter Sallis) is a well-meaning but slightly dim-witted inventor who lives with his intelligent and resourceful dog, Gromit (voiced by Peter Sallis). They run a pest control business in their quiet town of Wigan. However, their services are not in high demand due to the town's low population.

One day, a new restaurant opens in town, owned by the beautiful and cunning Lady Tottington (voiced by Helena Bonham Carter), who hires Wallace and Gromit to catch the town's pesky rabbits that have been causing trouble. The duo is thrilled at the opportunity but soon discovers that they are not as skilled at catching rabbits as they thought.

As the story progresses, it becomes clear that Lady Tottington has a secret: she is actually a princess from the kingdom of Tottington, and her father, King Rupert (voiced by Richard Wilson), has been searching for her. However, she has been forced to disguise herself as a commoner due to a curse placed upon her by an evil sorcerer.

The curse transforms Lady Tottingon into a were-rabbit whenever the full moon rises, causing chaos and destruction in the town. Wallace and Gromit team up with Lady Tottington to break the curse and find a way to reverse its effects before the next full moon.

Throughout their journey, Wallace and Gromit encounter various obstacles, including a sinister exterminator named Victor (voiced by Steve Pemberton) who is also after Lady Tottington. As they work together to solve the mystery of the were-rabbit curse, Wallace and Gromit's friendship and partnership are put to the test.

In the end, Wallace and Gromit successfully break the curse by using a combination of science and magic. The full moon passes without incident, and Lady Tottington is finally able to return to her true form as a princess. The movie ends with Wallace and Gromit returning to their normal lives, but not before they share a heartwarming moment together.

The Curse of the Were-Rabbit is a charming and entertaining film that showcases Aardman Animations' signature stop-motion animation style. The movie features witty humor, clever plot twists, and lovable characters, making it a delightful watch for audiences of all ages.

overview: Set before the events of ‘Soul’, 22 refuses to go to Earth, enlisting a gang of 5 new souls in attempt of rebellion. However, 22’s subversive plot leads to a surprising revelation about the meaning of life.
title: 22 vs. Earth
plot:
22 vs. Earth is a 2021 American animated short film produced by Pixar Animation Studios, directed by Kevin Nolting and written by Josh Cooley. It is a prequel to Pixar's 2020 feature Soul and centers on 22, the cynical unborn soul voiced by Tina Fey, as she attempts to stop other souls from leaving for Earth. Alice Braga and Richard Ayoade return as the soul counselors known as Jerrys, with Micah Chen and Adela Drabek among the voices of 22's recruits. The short was released on Disney+ on April 30, 2021.

The story is set long before the events of Soul, in the Great Before, the realm where new souls develop their personalities and search for the "spark" that will make them ready to be born. 22 has watched every friend she ever had complete their badge and depart for Earth, and she has grown to resent the planet for taking them away. After failing to talk one soul out of leaving, she decides to take drastic action. She abducts five young souls and inducts them into a secret resistance movement with the lengthy acronym APOCALYPSE, which stands for "Anonymous Provocateurs and Other Culprits Against Leaving Your friends to go to Pathetic Stupid Earth."

Giving her recruits nicknames, Macaroni, Zimmy, Peanut, D-Pac and Moonbeam, 22 trains them in her mission of preventing souls from finding their sparks. Her plans backfire almost at once, as one recruit after another discovers an inspiration and leaves for Earth. Eventually only Macaroni remains, and when he hugs 22 as her last friend, that devotion completes his own spark. Heartbroken but defiant, 22 sends him off to Earth herself and vows that the planet will never take her the way it has taken all of her friends. Watching from afar, the two counselors wonder when 22 will finally go to Earth and discover the meaning of life, and when one asks what that meaning is, the answer is cut off by the closing credits. A post-credits scene shows a counselor who has learned the answer and found it underwhelming.

Nolting, who had served as editor of Soul, said the short was conceived to explain why 22 refuses to go to Earth, describing it as the midpoint of her story with Soul as the third act. Soul director Pete Docter asked him to make it more child-friendly. Reviews were favorable, with critics calling it a funny insight into 22's loneliness and a welcome companion to the feature.

original_title: Wizards of Waverly Place: The Movie
overview: A young wizard accidentally conjures a spell that puts her family in jeopardy.
tagline: Family vacations can be tricky.
title: Wizards of Waverly Place: The Movie
plot: During a family vacation, Alex, a young witch, accidentally casts a curse on her loved ones. To reverse this, she tries to find a magical stone while her brother tries to keep their parents together.

original_title: そらのおとしものFinal 永遠の私の鳥籠
overview: Ikaros is an Angeloid and falls out of the sky. Tomoki Sakurai is a boy who believes the most important thing is to live a peaceful life. The two live tougher. Tomoki Sakurai has never seen Ikaros smile. Tomoki Sakurai sees Nymph and Astraea laugh after they got free from the master’s rule. He hopes Ikaros can laugh like an ordinary girl.  This movie wraps up the story of Tomoki Sakurai and his relationship with the Angeloid from the sky, Ikaros.
tagline: Always Smiling
